or how I got there. It's a miracle.

the odds and wake up here.

jp:

jp: いいけど　なに？

元気になったら

jp: へえ……
us: Huh...

Shinra'll just roll in and round 'em all up!

bother going through the motions.

us: An idiot, I know.

folks who'll risk it all.

jp: おい！
us: Wait!

us: Don't tell me you're going!

jp: あ～　もう！

jp: ああ
us: Yeah?

us: Yeah, mine too... What's that about, anyway?

us: Good question.

jp: 俺はさ
us: Y'know...

jp: うん？
us: Mm?

jp: うん
us: Yeah?

jp: いいじゃないの

us: And who might that be?

us: Uh... Whoever brought you back, I guess?

us: And assuming there was someone, who could it have been?

jp: おう
us: Copy.

us: Well, at least Shinra was a no-show too, right?

us: Who's there!?

あーんな　雑なポスターで集まるヤツらの

for a reason. Some higher purpose.

when the going gets tough...

Something like that!

and hold on tight and never let go.

pay a visit to Cloud when I get the chance.

us: Seeya!

かならず会えるよ

us: Don't look up... Don't look up...

あの空も

us: Oh! I can lay out the meat!

us: Okay! Then I'll cut up the veggies.

仕事ばっかりしててゴメン

us: Then let's hit up all the places we haven't been to yet!

us: So...what do you think's gonna happen to our baby?

us: Don't know...

us: ...Always hoped I'd find that special someone before I bit the dust.

jp:

jp: オレじゃ……ダメか？
us: What about...me?

えっ　ホントか！
なんだよ　そうくるか？
us: Wait, you mean it? You should've said something sooner!

us: Did she get caught up in that giant twister?

わかんないけど
重傷ってわけじゃないみたいだよ
us: I dunno, but thankfully it sounds like she wasn't hurt too bad.

jp:
裂け目の向こうは

思い出におひとつどうですか

家族といっしょに過ごす毎日って

jp:

jp:
お宝　マテリア　どっこかな～？
恥ずかしがらず～　出ておいで～♪
us:
My precious materia, where are you?
No need to be shy─come out!
Yuffie's gonna take you home!♪

jp:
す……す～ぴ～
むニャむニャむニャむニャ……
us: Zzz...
Zzz...

jp: 星とともにあらんことを
us: Blessings of the planet upon you.

jp: ここでは星命学の学習者がともに語り合い
us: Disciples of her teachings gather here to share their experiences.

jp:
星と生きる喜びを再確認するための
セミナーが開かれております
us: Through these seminars we learn from one another, and together enrich our lives.

jp:
セミナーの参加には
しかるべき　指導者の紹介が必要になります
us: Participation in the seminars requires a special invitation from a mentor.

jp: ですから　申し訳ありませんね
us: Without one, I'm afraid you cannot join.

jp:
本日は『星送りの儀』が執り行われますので
そちらに参加されては　いかがでしょう？
us: Perhaps you might instead consider taking part in the River of Lights ceremony. I suspect you'd enjoy it.

jp: 星命学セミナーは紹介制となっております
us: Our planetology seminars are open to invitees only.

jp: この人たちだよ　じっちゃん！
us: Oh! These're the friends I was talking about.

jp:
ホーホーホウ
ナナキが　世話になったそうだのう
us: Thank you for looking after Nanaki.

jp: わしは　ブーゲンハーゲン
us: My name is Bugenhagen.

jp:
すこしばかり　星には詳しくてな
コスモキャニオンで　星命学を教えている
us: I teach planetology here in the canyon. One could say I know a thing or two about our world.

jp:
すこしだなんて
じっちゃんは知らないことなんて　ないだろ？
us: "A thing or two"? I doubt there's a thing or two you don't know about it!

jp: そりゃ　子供のおまえよりは知っておるわい
us: Well, it might seem that way to a child like yourself.

jp: オイラだって　もう４８歳だよ
us: I'm not a child anymore─I'm forty-eight!

jp: よんじゅう？
us: Forty-what!?

jp: ナナキの一族は長命じゃ
us: Nanaki here has a long life ahead of him.

jp:
人間の寿命に当てはめると
まだ１５～１６歳といったところじゃの
us:
In human terms, I would say he's about...
fifteen or sixteen years old.

jp:
もうオトナだ！
この谷だって　じっちゃん達だって守れる
us:
That's more than old enough!
I can protect our vale and everyone in it.

jp: オイラは　チチとは違うんだから
us:
Which is more than I can say for
my good-for-nothing father.

jp:
ナナキよ　もう谷の者たちへの挨拶は
すんだのかのう？
us: Speaking of the members of our little community, have you announced your return to one and all, Nanaki?

jp: まだ……行ってくる
us: Not yet... Be right back.

jp:
失礼したのう
よければ　中も見学してゆくといい
us:
But where are my manners?
Please, come in and have a look around.

jp:
ナナキを鍛えてくれたそうじゃな
外の世界を知って　たくましくなったかな
us: Nanaki never had much exposure to the outside world. I can only hope his travels with you have served to enlighten him.

jp:
ホーホーホウ
めずらしい器械がいっぱいじゃろう
us: Have my devices piqued your curiosity?

jp: ぜーんぶ　星とつながる道具じゃ
us: They are essential to my studies of the planet.

jp: それは　ごく初期の魔晄探知器じゃ
us: That is one of the first mako detectors ever built.

jp:
ふ～む……
いよいよ　寿命かのう
us: Though I suspect it can't detect much now.

jp: 星の営みを記録するための器械じゃよ
us: That records fluctuations in various energies.

jp:
デリケートな代物だからの
扱いには気をつけるのじゃぞ
us: I must ask that you handle it with care. It's a rather delicate device, you see.

jp: 星とその周辺の星々の縮図じゃ
us: That's a scale model of our planet and the surrounding stars.

jp:
さしずめ　積もったホコリが
人間といったところかの
us: One could say the dust it's collected represents the people who live upon it.

jp:
星を巡る記憶の結晶……
目で見える以上の輝きが　そこには秘められておる
us: While that may appear to be little more than a glistening mineral at a glance, it is in fact a crystallized collection of our planet's memories.

jp:
ホーホウ！
それに触ると　雪崩を起こすぞぃ
us: Those "devices" are testing the pull of gravity.

jp: ホッホ　まだまだあるぞぃ
us: There's more to see upstairs.

jp:
それは　気流発生器の模型じゃ
風力で動き　新たな風の流れを生み出す
us: That right there is a type of a current generator. It harnesses the power of the wind to produce new airflows of its own.

jp: 実物は　もう見たことがあるかの？
us: Perhaps you've encountered them before during your travels.

jp:
ナナキの昔の映像じゃ
あの頃は　イタズラばかりしておったのう
us: Do you recognize that little scamp? I'll have you know that, in his childhood, Nanaki was quite a handful.

jp: そう急くでない　そこはあとでな
us: Let's not be hasty. I'll show you that room later.

jp:
世界いちの大きさの
星々の営みを観測する望遠鏡じゃ
us: You won't find a larger telescope on the planet. With it, you can see to the edge of the galaxy!

jp:
こいつで見る星空は最高なんじゃが
いまはレンズが曇ってしまっておる
us: There's no better view of the stars than through this scope, but the lens could do with some cleaning.

jp: すまないのう
us: My apologies.

jp: ううん　これは……？
us: Hmm... That again, eh?

jp: この声……？
us: That's...

jp:
星の悲鳴　悲しげな調べじゃ
最近　よく聞くようになった
us:
The planet crying out. A sorrowful dirge indeed...
One I've heard all too often of late.

jp:
伝声管を伝って
地中深くから聞こえてくるのじゃよ
us:
This tubing allows us on the surface
to hear the inner voice of the planet.

jp:
これは星の悲鳴ではありません
星を守るウェポンの声です
us: What we just heard didn't come from the planet though. That was definitely the voice of a Weapon.

jp: ずいぶん　ハッキリ言いきるのう
us: Hmm... You seem awfully sure of yourself, miss.

jp: 私たち　ウェポンを見たんです
us: Because we saw them─with our own eyes.

jp:
ゴンガガとコレルの魔晄炉で
すごく大きくて……
us:
Two─in the Corel and Gongaga reactors.
They were loud and huge...

jp:
ホーホーホウ！
それは　興味深い話じゃのう
us: A fascinating account...were it true.

jp:
が……魔晄中毒の症状は様々じゃ
気をつけるのじゃよ
us: However, such grand delusions could be a sign of mako poisoning. Do see a doctor.

jp: えっ　あの……
us: Um, excuse me?

jp: ホーホウ……そうか　そうか
us: ...Yes, that would do them some good.

jp:
おまえさんたちは　どうやら
きちんと星命学を学んだことがないようだ
us: Judging from everything you've said, the three of you are unfamiliar with basic planetology.

jp: 良い機会だ　こちらへ来なさい
us:
But it is never too late to learn.
Please, come with me.

jp: これは　星命学習器
us: I present to you: our planetarium.

jp:
最新型が神羅本社にあるらしいが
これは　わしが作ったオリジナルじゃ
us: While the Shinra Building features the latest iteration, this particular one is my original design.

jp: では　はじめよう
us: Now then, without further ado...

jp: きれい
us: Wow...

jp: ホーホウ　驚くのはまだ早い
us: This is only the beginning.

jp: あっ　流れ星！
us: A shooting star!

jp: 星と宇宙　そこに生きるもの　その仕組み
us: Planetology is not simply the study of the cosmos and the celestial bodies that dwell in it.

jp: 命の流れを知ることは　星命学の基本じゃ
us: Rather, it is a quest to comprehend the cyclical nature of life.

jp: この星は　わしらの星
us: Behold─the planet we call "home."

jp: 豊かな命に溢れたこの星に　人は生まれた
us: It was from its soil, so teeming with life, that mankind was born.

jp: 人は生き　やがていつか死ぬ
us: And like all living things, man is fated to die.

jp: じゃが　死んだらどうなる？
us: So...what happens next?

jp: 体は朽ち　星に帰る
us: The body withers and returns to the planet.

jp: では　意識　心　精神はどうじゃ？
us: But what of the mind? The spirit? The soul?

jp: 実は精神も同じく　星に帰るのじゃな
us: Much like its former vessel, it too returns whence it came.

jp: 星に帰った精神は混じりあい　星を駆け巡る
us: To the great river where all intertwine and circle the planet without end.

jp:
星を巡り　混じり　分かれ
ライフストリームと呼ばれるうねりとなる
us: A cycle of continuous convergence and divergence. The ceaseless ebb and flow that is the lifestream.

jp:
ライフストリーム……
すなわち星を巡る　精神的エネルギーの流れじゃな
us: An apt name, though it is as much a reservoir as it is a stream, being the sum of the planet's spiritual energy.

jp:
星が星であるためには
精神エネルギーが必要なんじゃ
us: It is the very essence of our star─the blood coursing through its planetary veins.

jp: じゃが　その精神エネルギーがなくなれば
us: And...if ever that essence were to be entirely depleted...

jp: これが　星命学の基礎中の基礎
us:
Of course,
these are but basic principles of planetology.

jp:
魔晄は　精神エネルギーの浪費
これは事実なんだな？
us:
So you're saying that mako is
"spiritual energy," which we're using up.

jp: そのとおり
us: Just so.

jp:
吸い上げられ　加工された精神エネルギーは
もう本来の役目を果たさない
us: Siphoned from the planet and processed for industry, that energy can no longer fulfill its true purpose.

jp: 機械の中で消費され　消えていくのじゃ
us: It is fated to fuel man's machinery, then fade away.

jp: 本当に　消えるんでしょうか？
us: Okay, but does it actually fade away?

jp:
そうではなくて　ライフストリームに帰って
なにか別のものになるということはありませんか？
us: I mean, what if it doesn't? What if it just returns to the lifestream in a different form? Is that possible?

jp: 新説……いや　珍説じゃな
us: A novel theory...suggestive of a lack of understanding.

jp:
おぬしは　セミナーに参加したほうが
良さそうじゃの
us:
However, that can be overcome
with time and education.

jp: お呼びでしょうか？
us: You rang?

jp: お嬢さんを　セミナー室へ案内してあげなさい
us: Please escort this young lady to our seminar room, would you?

jp: こちらへどうぞ
us: Right this way.

jp: はい……
us: Okay...

jp: わたしも
us: Hey, can I come?

jp: ブーゲンハーゲン
us: Got a question.

jp:
巡る命が消えれば
星は壊れ　終わる
us: Planet runs outta energy. It─and everything on it─dies. Right?

jp: 避ける方法はないのか
us: There any way to avoid this?

jp: たとえば　巡る命を強くするとか
us: Like...making the spiritual energy stronger?

jp: そんなことは知らん！
us: Why are you asking me such things!?

jp: だが　わしの星命学はもう古いのかもしれん
us: I'm sorry... I've come to realize that I'm somewhat stuck in the past.

jp:
これほど　人が星に深く関与する時代など
かつてなかったことだ
us: We've entered an era in which humanity exerts unprecedented influence over its environs.

jp: 星も人も変わる
us: And as both the planet and society evolve...

jp: 星命学もな
us: so too must science.

jp:
わしはもうジジイじゃ
学びきれないのは　寂しいのう
us: And yet, it seems that I cannot. Perhaps I'm much too old of a dog to learn any new tricks.

jp:
おぬしは星命学に興味ないのか？
セミナーに参加するのが良かろう
us: Was my explanation of planetology not to your liking? Perhaps a seminar would provide a more agreeable experience.

jp:
見ろよ　今日は『星送り』って祭の日らしい
あとでちょっくら　見に行こうぜ
us: Look at this. They're holdin' some festival today called "the River of Lights." Thinkin' it could be worth checkin' out.

jp:
あれもこれも　ぜ～んぶニセモノ！
つまんない場所だよね
us: This village is lame! Did you know none of the materia here's even real?

jp:
星命学とかってのも　どうせニセモノの学者が
エラそーなこと言ってるだけなんでしょ？
us: And don't get me started on the planetologists! Buncha blowhards in love with the sound of their own voice.

jp: こんな古い書物　よう残ってましたな～
us: These tomes are ancient! How they haven't turned to dust I'll never know!

jp:
古い紙のええ香り
なんや　ウットリしてきましたわ
us: Ah, that classic old-book smell. One whiff and you're transported to another place and time...

jp:
ブーゲンハーゲン様から話は聞いております
どうぞ　お進みください
us: Fellow Bugenhagen sent word that you might be joining us. You are more than welcome to do so.

jp: もうすぐ『星送りの儀』が執り行われます
us: The River of Lights ceremony will begin shortly.

jp:
年にいちど　コスモキャニオンが
星と結ばれる夜です
us: This night comes but once a year, bringing us closer to the planet.

jp: あなたにもきっと祝福がありますよ
us: I've no doubt you'll feel her grace.

jp:
私は小さい頃から　体は大きいものの
力仕事より絵画や詩が好きで
us: I've, uh...always been on the bigger side, but...I've never been into physical stuff. Painting and poetry are more my thing.

jp:
家の中で過ごす私を　父はいつも
情けないと嘆いていました
us: My old man, he...he used to say it was a "waste," me spending all my time indoors.

jp:
父の理屈では　私は人一倍
大量の精神エネルギーを浪費している
星のお荷物ということになります
us: According to him, a big kid like me was using twice as much spiritual energy as other folks...and I was a "burden on the planet."

jp: でも　違うと思うんです
us: But...he was wrong.

jp:
私は他人より多くの精神エネルギーを
星から預かって
us: That extra energy I received from the planet? It was a blessing.

jp:
豊かな知性と情緒で質を高め
いつか星に返すのです
us: And after imbuing it with my compassion and intellect, I'll give it right back.

jp:
それが私の
人生の意味だと信じています
us: No way is that a waste. It's just the opposite.

jp: すばらしい！
us: Indeed it is! Thank you for sharing!

jp: 星とともにあらんことを！
us: Blessings of the planet be upon you!

jp: さあ　次は誰が話しますか？
us: Now, would anyone else like to share their story with the group?

jp:
わたしは父と母がまだ生きている
もうひとつの世界があると信じています
us: So...my parents are no longer with us─here, that is─but I believe they're still out there, on another plane.

jp:
どうにかしてその世界に行きたいと考え
勉強を続けているのです
us: I've been reading a bunch of theories about this alternate world in the hope of going there someday.

jp:
そして　ここで
素晴らしい教えを授かりました
us: And over the course of my studies, I stumbled across a fascinating theory.

jp:
ライフストリーム……精神エネルギー
その正体は　知識や記憶だと聞きました
us: It addressed the issue of what the lifestream is, arguing that spiritual energy is actually a manifestation of our knowledge and memories.

jp: でも　区別は曖昧ですよね
us: Like I said, it's a fascinating theory...

jp:
もしかすると　願いや夢も
混じり合っているのではないか
us: but it's incomplete. What about our hopes and dreams? We remember those, don't we?

jp:
精神エネルギーは
現実の記憶と実現しなかった願いや夢を
区別しないのではないか
us: So, what if spiritual energy doesn't distinguish between our real, lived memories and the unrealized desires buried deep in our hearts?

jp:
そんなエネルギーに偶然触れた時
人は　別の世界を見るのではないか
us: What if coming into contact with that energy allowed us to "peer through the looking glass," so to speak?

jp:
それが　ここでの学びから
辿り着いた解釈です
us: It's just an idea, but...I hope to find the truth someday.

jp: 今後とも　学びを忘れないでくださいね
us: And may the bounty of the planet's knowledge be with you forevermore.

jp:
さあ　次は誰が話しますか？
準備ができたら　教えてください
us: Now, then─would anyone else like to share their story? Don't be shy. Every contribution is welcome.

jp: そこのあなた
us: What about you, miss?

jp: あなたの体験談を聞かせてください
us: You must have a story to share. Please.

jp: ……はい
us: Me...? Okay.

jp: 私　その……
us: I, uh... Where to begin?

jp: ライフストリームに落ちたんです
us: I fell into the lifestream.

jp: ライフストリームの中は　とても美しいところで
us:
I don't have words to describe it─
except "beautiful," maybe?

jp: いろんなことを思い出すんです
us: It was...a lot to take in.

jp:
だれかに優しい気持ちになれたり
忘れていた想いをつないでくれたり
us:
Feelings of kindness washed over me─
long-forgotten memories came flooding back.

jp: 星の中は　あたたかい場所なんです
us: It was a warm, comforting place.

jp: でも　そこには戦いもありました
us: But there was also conflict.

jp: 星と星をおびやかす敵との戦いです
us: A war─between the planet and its enemies.

jp:
私は……私たちは
星とともに生きなくてはなりません
us:
And I can't─ I mean, we can't let them win.
We need the planet, and it needs us.

jp:
星といっしょに
敵に……危機に立ち向かうべきなんです
us:
We have to rise up─fight back─defend it
from this terrible threat.

jp: でも　戦い方がまだわかりません
us: Thing is, I don't know how to do any of that.

jp: ここで　わかると思ったんですけど
us: And I hoped you might have the answer...

jp:
星命学を批判してるわけじゃないんです
怖がらせるつもりもありません
us:
I'm not criticizing planetology or anything─
and I'm not trying to scare anybody either.

jp: ただ　ええと……
us: I just... You know...

jp: ごめんなさい　うまく話せなくて
us: Never mind. This is all coming out wrong.

jp: 気にすることはありませんよ
us: Please, do not be discouraged.

jp:
私たちは　いつでもここで
あなたを待っています
us:
Should you ever wish to try again,
we would be more than happy to listen.

jp:
考えることを続けなさい
答えは　その果てにしかありません
us: What matters is that you keep challenging your beliefs. Stop doing that, and the answers will forever elude you.

jp:
さあ　そろそろ星送りの刻限です
みなさん　キャンドルへと向かいましょう
us:
On that note, I think we should adjourn for the
evening. The River of Lights is almost upon us,
so let us head to the Torch.

jp: 先に行ってるね
us: I'll see you at the festival.

jp: 今日は　星送りの日
us: Ah, the River of Lights...

jp:
年にいちど　谷に吹き寄せられた魂を
星へと帰すのです
us: Once a year, we gather the souls that have drifted to our vale and return them to the planet whence they came.

jp: あなたも参加されると良いでしょう
us: I heartily encourage you to join us in this ceremony.

jp: さっき　メンターと話したんだけどよ
us: I had the "pleasure" of talking to a mentor.

jp: 人が星を救おうなんて　おこがましいってよ
us:
Said it was "presumptuous" of me
to think I could save the planet.

jp:
星の未来は　星が決める
星が汚れたら　星が掃除をするだろうってな
us: She "decides her own fate," you see. "As rain cleanses the skies, so too does she cleanse herself of filth."

jp:
オレたちは　ほっとけってか？
黙って勉強してろってか
us: So what─we sit here and "theorize" while the planet "rinses and repeats"?

jp: 戦わなければ　なにも変わらない
us: No, we fight. Or nothing will change.

jp:
だろ？　これからも頼りにしてるぜ
クラウドさんよ
us:
That's what I said!
I knew you'd see it my way, merc. Thanks.

jp: あんたは　どうしたいんだ？
us: Whadda you wanna do?

jp:
ほっとくなんてできるか！
でもな　戦うだけってのも違う気はしてる
us: Not nothing, that's for damn sure! At the same time, though...I don't know if fighting's the answer anymore.

jp: 守るためには　どうすりゃいいんだろうな
us: Maybe it's time for some good old-fashioned introspection.

jp: ここで　もっと学べばいい
us: Maybe you'll learn something.

jp:
星命学は　ただの学問だ
よーくわかったぜ
us: Oh, I've learned something alright. That these planetologists would rather study the world than live in it.

jp: 星命学　アバランチ　マリン　オレ……
us: Planetology, Avalanche, Marlene...and me. I dunno...

jp: 星は　なんて言ってんだろうな
us: The planet's tryin' to tell me somethin'. But what?

jp: 宇宙に比べたら　人間なんてちっぽけな存在
us: Some say we're like grains of sand on the beach of the universe...

jp:
そんなことを　したり顔で話す連中に
反発して生きてきましたけど
us: Fatalist idiots. Spent my whole life tryin' to prove 'em wrong.

jp: いや～ホンマに　ボクら　ちっさいんやねえ
us: But sittin' here, lookin' up at the sky...you cannae help feelin' pretty miniscule.

jp: 空は大きい　ボクは小さい
us: Like a grain of sand...on the beach that is the universe...

jp: なんや　色々考えてまうわ
us: Hmm... I'm warming to it.

jp: 死んだ人間が星に帰るとかゆーヤツ？
us: "When you die, you return to the planet"? Psh...

jp:
ぜんっぜん　これっぽ～っちも
信じてないんだよね　アタシ
us:
That has literally got to be the
dumbest thing I have ever heard.

jp: 死んだらぜーんぶ　パァでしょ？
us: Once you die, that's that.

jp: そうかもな
us: Pretty much.

jp:
でしょ？　だからさ
なにがなんでも生き抜くんだ　アタシは
us: Thank you! So, if you get that, you get why I live every day like it's my last.

jp: どうして　そう思うんだ？
us: Why do you think that?

jp: 理由なんてないよ
us: I just do.

jp: 自分で見たことないものは信じない　そんだけ
us: Why believe in anything else until I see some actual proof?

jp: ユフィ　正解だ
us: Yeah. I totally agree.

jp:
はぁ～？　あ～あ
クラウドに聞いたのがマチガイ
us: What!? Ugh, should've known better than to get philosophical with you.

jp: はやく終わんないかな～　これ
us: How much longer are they gonna be doin' this?

jp: 恥ずかしいとこ　見られちゃったな
us: Did I sound as awkward as I felt?

jp: あれでいい
us: You did good.

jp: わかるヤツにはわかる　聞く側の問題だ
us:
Can't help it if they suck at listening.
I got what you were saying.

jp: みんなにわかってほしかったな
us: I kinda wanted everyone to get it though.

jp: ティファは悪くない
us: To hell with "everyone."

jp: ありがとう　クラウド
us: Great advice. Thanks.

jp: 気にするな
us: Felt for ya.

jp: 話をするのは　俺も得意じゃない
us: Never been that good with words─as you know.

jp: お互い　苦労しますな
us: We're just two peas in a pod, aren't we?

jp: ああいうときは笑ってごまかせばいい
us: Just gotta laugh it off. It's that simple.

jp:
そういうのも　苦手なんだよね
私　まじめすぎるのかな
us: Except it's not─least, not for me... I dunno, maybe I'm too serious for my own good.

jp: 星がすごいね
us: Look at those stars...

jp: もうすこし　こうしていたいな
us: I think I'm gonna stay out here a little longer...

jp: オイラが　本当に子供だった頃
us: Look at them, gathered around the fire...

jp:
あの日もこんなふうに
ハハとチチと　この火を囲んで……
us:
Just like us that day─me and Mom and Dad.
If only we could do that again...

jp: ううん　やっぱりなんでもないや
us: Uh, never mind. Just forget I said anything.

jp: 話なら　聞くぞ
us: I'll lend an ear.

jp:
ハハの話をすると　オイラの胸は
誇らしい気持ちではち切れそうになるんだ
us: Whenever I think about my mom, my chest swells with so much pride I...I feel like it'll burst.

jp: でも　チチのことを思い出すと……
us: But, when it comes to my dad...I just...

jp: やっぱり　また今度話すよ
us: Sorry, I can't. Still not ready.

jp: 興味ないね
us: Wasn't listening.

jp:
クラウドのそういうところ
オイラは嫌いじゃないけどね
us: You can be an asshole sometimes, but you're our asshole.

jp: 話し出したのはそっちだ　途中でやめるな
us:
Don't gimme that bullshit.
You start a story, you finish it.

jp:
クラウド　私は最近
『デリカシー』という言葉を覚えたんだ
us:
Cloud. If I may...
allow me to add a new word to your lexicon.

jp:
デリカシーがないとか　足りないとか
そんな使い方をする
us:
"Decorum," meaning "polite behavior."
Often used in the negative like so:

jp: この言葉を　君に捧げるよ
us: "You sometimes exhibit a severe lack of decorum."

jp: もうすぐ　このお祭りのいちばんの見どころだよ
us: The most interesting part of the festival is about to start.

jp: グルルル……
us: Grr...

jp:
わたしは　古代種です
大昔にこの星を開拓した　セトラの末裔です
us: So...I'm an Ancient. As in "a steward of the planet." One of those Ancients.

jp: この世界に　もうひとりしかいません
us: Or to be more precise...the only Ancient.

jp: この血のせいで　わたしは……
us: For the most part...it's been a source of pain.

jp: 小さい頃から　監視されたり　閉じ込められたり
us:
I've been held against my will. I've been watched.
I've been ignored.

jp: 怖がられたり　たまに無視されたり
us:
Even hated.
And it's been that way ever since I was little.

jp: いいことなんて　ひとつもない
us: My blood's been nothing but a curse.

jp:
どんなに楽しいこと続いても
血のことを思うと　だいなし
us:
If I ever started to forget,
something would remind me of what I was,
and bring me crashing back down to earth.

jp: そんなことが　何度もありました
us: It was always the same. Time after time.

jp:
普通の生活なんて　できないんだって
あこがれたり　あきらめたり
us:
I'd be shown a glimmer of hope only to have it snatched away. I was never gonna be normal...
that much was clear.

jp: がんばれ
us: It's okay.

jp: そこまでだ！
us: That's enough!

jp: だいじょうぶです　続けます
us: It's okay. I'll keep going.

jp:
でも　そんなわたしだからこそ
出会えた仲間がいます　友達がいます
us: So, my blood's been a curse...but it's also been a blessing. It's brought some wonderful people into my life. Friends that I love.

jp: だから　もうだいじょうぶ　報われました
us: And for once...I think I'm okay. Happy, even.

jp: がまんしてきて　よかった
us: And all that pain...feels worth it.

jp:
ずっと　いっしょにいられるように
良い人でいよう　そう思っています
us: Even if I can't lead a normal life...there is one thing I can do─return their kindness.

jp: ふつうの人生は　無理でも
us: And try to make the most of what I've been given.

jp: さあ　送るのじゃ
us: There... It is time.

jp: 聞かれてしまったか
us: Pretty sappy, huh?

jp: がんばるね　わたし
us: Meant every word though.

jp: ここにいたのか　ナナキよ
us: So this is where you've been, Nanaki.

jp: じっちゃん
us: What's up?

jp:
おまえに話さねばならぬことがある
おぬしらも来てくれんか
us: There's something of great import I need to show you. And by that, I mean all of you. Join me, would you?

jp: 星送りの儀は　どう思ったかの？
us: What did you all think of the River of Lights?

jp:
最近は　なんだか知らんが
儀式目当ての客が増えてのう
us: For whatever reason, the ceremony has drawn a number of tourists to the vale as of late.

jp:
感想をたずねれば
綺麗　感動　壮大　泣けたとか
us: When I ask for their impressions, they often speak of how beautiful it was. Some claim they were even moved to tears.

jp: まあ　１０人いれば９人はそんな感じじゃ
us: It's an overwhelmingly positive reception, I'm happy to say.

jp:
心が動くのは良いことじゃ
星送りの儀に　その力があることは素晴らしい
us: To stir the human soul is no small feat, and it pleases me to know that the River of Lights possesses such power.

jp:
だが　一歩踏み込んで
星命学を学ぼうという者は　まあ～おらん
us: Alas, my hopes to parlay their emotional response into a deeper intellectual curiosity... They have yet to be fulfilled.

jp: 犬や猫　鳥　魚　そして草花
us: People are surrounded by cats, dogs, birds, and trees.

jp: みんな生きとることは　誰でも知っておる
us: They know that life is all around them.

jp:
赤ん坊が生まれる　花が芽吹く
そこには誰もが命の存在を感じるはずじゃ
us: Be it through the birth of a baby or the blooming of a flower, they bear constant witness to the blessed cycle of creation...

jp: 星も同じなんだがのう
us: yet they've no interest in the welfare of our planet.

jp: ホッホ……すまんの　ついグチグチと
us: Forgive me for sharing my idle thoughts.

jp: 歳をとると　愚痴と説教が止まらんわ
us: Keeping them to myself is quite a challenge in my old age.

jp:
ホーホーホウ！
では　行くとするかの
us: Well then, shall we proceed?

jp: でも　この扉って……
us: Uh...but I thought this door was...

jp:
さよう　わしが封印し
立ち入りを禁じてきた扉じゃ
us:
Sealed so that none may enter?
Why yes─and by my own hand, no less.

jp: これより　おまえに試験を受けてもらう
us: However, you've a trial to undertake.

jp: えっ？
us: I do?

jp:
この谷を守る戦士になりたければ
避けては通れまい
us:
If you wish to prove yourself and
become a Watcher of the Vale, that is.

jp: 覚悟はできたな？
us: I presume you are prepared?

jp: うん
us: Yeah.

jp: 試験には　おぬしたちの協力が必要じゃ
us:
I will also require your assistance
in carrying out the trial.

jp:
少しばかり　危険なところへ行くのでな
準備ができたら　声をかけてくれ
us: Much danger awaits within, and I wish to ensure his safety. When you're ready, simply say the word.

jp: 行けそうかな？
us: Shall we begin?

jp: では　行こう
us: Then off we go.

jp: この洞窟を　奥へ奥へと進むのじゃ
us: Now we follow the cave where it leads, deep as it will take us.

jp: ナナキから　両親の話は聞いたかな？
us: Has Nanaki told you anything about his parents yet?

jp: いや
us: Nope.

jp:
オイラの両親は
ふたりとも　谷を守る戦士だった
us: They were Watchers, both of them─but they couldn't have been any more different.

jp:
だから　敵が谷に攻め込んで来たとき
ハハは勇敢に戦い　命を懸けて谷を守った
us: When our village came under attack, my mother fought with courage. With honor. She faced the enemy and laid down her life to save us.

jp:
でも　卑怯者のチチは……
ひとりで逃げ出したんだ
us: My father, though...he turned tail and ran. He was a coward.

jp: やはり　セトは許せんか
us: So then, you still haven't forgiven him?

jp: あたりまえだよ
us: Why would I?

jp: ホーホウ　ホウ……
us: I see...

jp: ホーホーホウ！
us: Ho ho...!

jp:
ここから先に進むのは
試験を受ける者と見届ける者　ふたりのみじゃ
us: From this point onward, only two may proceed: he who shall undertake the trial, and his observer.

jp: じゃあ　オイラと……
us: Who's gonna observe?

jp: 俺が行く
us: I'll do it.

jp:
ホーホウホウ
おぬしでは　ナナキの修行にならん
us: That would render the trial meaningless.

jp: そうじゃのお
us: But if not him...

jp: おぬしが適任じゃな
us: Ah, you'll do nicely.

jp: あん？
us: Me!?

jp: ええ～？
us: Him!? Really!?

jp: おまえ　遠慮がなくなったよな
us: At least pretend not to hate me.

jp: ホッホウ　準備をしっかりな
us: Whenever you're ready.

jp: はーい
us: Ready...

jp: 準備ができたら　出発じゃ！
us: Make sure that you are well prepared.

jp:
洞窟内は危険です
じゅうぶんにお気をつけくださいますよう
us: These caves can be perilous, even for seasoned Watchers. Be careful.

jp: 星とともにあらんことを
us: Blessings of the planet upon you.

jp: ちゃんと見ててよ？
us: You gonna watch my back?

jp: おう　穴があくほどな
us: Yep. Burnin' holes in ya right now.

jp: ここって……
us: What is this?

jp:
谷底に封じられし者達
その悲しみの渦巻く場所じゃ
us: This is a place of deep sorrow─a place where those who have been sealed away are left to mourn their fates.

jp: これを見よ　ナナキ
us: Nanaki, look here.

jp: おまえならば　登れるはずじゃ
us: Such walls should be well within your power to climb.

jp: ったく　身軽でいいよな
us: Damn if that doesn't look convenient.

jp: おい　置いてく気かよ
us: I only got two legs here, ya know!

jp: おう　どこまで行きやがった～？
us: Hey! Where'd you run off to?

jp: 気味が悪いぜ
us: This place is givin' me the creeps.

jp:
４０と５年前のことじゃ
苛烈な戦いが　ここで繰り広げられた
us: Your discomfort is only natural. A fierce battle was waged here, and even after forty-five years, the scars remain fresh.

jp:
まさか　ギ族は
こんなところまで入り込んでいたの？
us: What? You're saying the Gi managed to make it all the way up here!?

jp: なんだ　そのギなんとかってのはよ
us: Okay, somebody fill me in. Who're the Gi?

jp:
この谷の者以外　存在すら知らぬ一族じゃ
まあ　そうあせるでない　じきわかる
us: A tribe known to very few people outside of the vale. The rest you will learn in due time, of that you can be certain. For now, let us proceed.

jp:
おう　じいさん
片付くまで　どっか隠れとけ！
us: We got this covered. You just float yourself up into a nook.

jp: ホッホウ　言われんでもそうするわい
us: As if I weren't going to already.

jp: 死んでんのか？
us: What the hell is that?

jp: 彼らが　ギ族じゃ
us: That...is a Gi.

jp: おっきいんだね
us: It's huge...

jp: 外見だけで　物事の本質を捉えることはできぬ
us: Under normal circumstances, I would stress that you mustn't judge a book by its cover.

jp: が……事実　彼らの力は強大だった
us: For the Gi, however... They are as fearsome as their appearance implies.

jp: こいつらに　ハハは……
us: These are the things that killed my mom?

jp: ナナキよ　最初の試験じゃ
us: Nanaki, this shall be your first trial.

jp:
ここでなにが起きたのか
おまえなりに探ってみい
us:
You are to explore this place─
understand the nature of its history.

jp: わかった
us: Okay. Will do.

jp: 我らの遺物を探し　運び　真実を解き明かせ さすれば　道は開けるであろう
us: Seek the relic of our past, carry it forth, and bring the truth to light. Only then, shall the path reveal itself unto you.

jp: 否　正しき遺物を探せ……
us: Nay... That is not the relic we seek.

jp: ホーホウ　それはただの骨じゃな
us: That is but a mere bone!

jp:
ほう　これは……
おまえのオモチャに　ちょうど良さそうじゃの
us: This is...I'm not sure, but I'm pleased to see that you're enjoying yourself.

jp: ホー……ホーホゥ……
us: Ho...ho ho...

jp: すまぬ　寝てしまったわい
us: Sorry. I haven't slept well of late.

jp: おお　戦いの記憶…… 我らが目覚めの時は近い……
us: Memories of war... The hour of our awakening draws nigh!

jp: ほう　ギ族の矢か
us: Well, if it isn't a Gi arrow.

jp:
矢尻の先に塗られた毒は　瞬く間に体を巡り
石のように動かなくなってしまうという話じゃ
us: Its point is coated with a poison that rapidly circulates through the body, slowing the wounded until they are completely turned to stone.

jp: 谷の者が使っていた武器じゃな
us: Ah, yes. An armament of the vale.

jp:
柄に施されたこの文様　おまえの体にも
同じものが描かれているじゃろうて
us: The carvings on its hilt should look familiar. Indeed, you'll find the very same markings on your own body!

jp:
星を巡る魂の記憶　知識　その結晶
一般的には　マテリアと呼ばれておるようじゃの
us: Most would call that "materia," but it is far more than a "magic stone." It is a crystallized collection of the planet's memories and knowledge!

jp: おお　我らの亡骸　ギ族の想い……
us: Ah... A remnant of our struggles─of our desires.

jp: おい　離せ！
us: Get rid of that thing!

jp: 我らが苦しみ　呼び覚ますのは誰だ！
us: In suffering we stir... Who wakes us from our slumber!?

jp: いまのは　ギ族の亡霊じゃ
us: That specter you fought was a fallen Gi.

jp:
我々との戦いで滅びた後も　憎悪が募り
こうして　洞窟をさまよっているのじゃよ
us: Even in death, their lingering enmity manifests as such─they who wander in search of retribution.

jp: しつこいなあ
us: That's kinda pathetic.

jp:
彼らには　彼らの事情がある
敗者を下に見てはいかん
us:
Do not be so quick to denigrate your enemies,
nor make light of their plight.

jp:
この石像とて　故あってここに存在しておるのじゃ
無下に扱うでない
us: Consider this statue. It has been placed in this chamber for a reason. Handle it with the utmost care.

jp: は～い
us: I will.

jp: 我らの亡骸　石像を運べ……
us: Deliver unto us the remnants of our past.

jp: ここは　祭壇？
us: Are these...altars?

jp:
どっちかっつーと
呪いの間って感じじゃねーか？
us: Interesting, 'cause my first thought was "Are we gonna make it outta this place alive?"

jp:
ホーホーホウ！
なかなか　面白い見立てじゃの
us: Its décor is indeed the opposite of inviting.

jp: この像……さっきの？
us: These look like the statue I picked up.

jp: すべてのことに意味はある
us: If there is a reason for everything...

jp: すべてのことに意味がないのと同じじゃ
us: then one could argue that everything has no reason.

jp: すべきことはわかるな　ナナキ
us: Regardless, you know what you must do, don't you?

jp: 我らの亡骸……石像を運び 正しき祭壇にまつれ
us: Deliver unto us the remnants of our past. Restore them to their rightful place.

jp: 否　正しき祭壇にまつれ
us: Nay, the remnant seeks its rightful place.

jp: おお　我らの恨み　封じるか……
us: Our rancor begins to fade...

jp: 来るか　来んのか？
us: Marlene, Daddy loves you!

jp: おわり？
us: That it?

jp: ホーホウ　はじまりじゃよ
us: Not in the least.

jp: おお　我らの怒り　封じるか……
us: Our anger gives way to calm...

jp: おお　我らの悲しみ　封じるか……
us: Our sadness sinks beneath stone...

jp:
数千年の昔　この谷の歴史は
ギ族の訪れとともに始まった
us: The history of the vale is intertwined with the Gi, for they first came to these lands many millennia ago.

jp:
この祭壇は　その頃
ギ族を封じるために作られたものなのじゃよ
us:
This sanctuary is proof of their persistence, for
it was built to ensure that they never escaped.

jp:
大昔に封印されたはずのギ族が
どうしてあの日　谷を襲ったの？
us: But, if they were sealed away thousands of years ago, how'd they break out and attack the vale?

jp: 彼らの真実は　彼らにしかわからん
us: That I cannot answer. Only the Gi themselves could.

jp: 行こう　おまえの真実を探しに
us:
But enough about them─
you are here to learn about yourself, Nanaki.

jp: この洞窟は　ギ族と人の世との境界線
us: This cave serves as a boundary between our world and that of the Gi.

jp:
ここから　ギ族に攻め込まれたら
谷は　ひとたまりもなかったじゃろうな
us: It was vital to them and their plans. Were the Gi to seize control of it, the canyon would be doomed.

jp: そうだね
us: And the people.

jp:
しかし　ある戦士が
この無防備な洞窟に気づいた
us: When the Gi moved against us yet again, a certain Watcher recalled this vulnerability.

jp:
戦士はたったひとり　この洞窟へとやってきた
案の定　中はギ族でいっぱいになっておった
us: Since time was of the essence, he entered the cave without reinforcements. As he had feared, it was teeming with Gi─ready to descend upon the village.

jp:
次から次へと襲いかかるギ族と戦い
戦士は走りに走った
us: Determined to protect the vale, he pounced from one foe to the next─felling all who dared oppose him.

jp:
ねえ　じっちゃん　そんな勇敢な戦士なら
オイラは知ってるはずだよ
us: Hold on. If there was a Watcher who single-handedly saved the canyon, how come I've never heard of them?

jp: ホーホウ
us: Ho ho...!

jp:
ここから先は　より注意深くな
邪気が強くなっておる
us: For now you should focus on your own struggles with the Gi. Their malice grows more potent.

jp: なんとまあ　こりゃあ
us: It's definitely got...ambience?

jp: 怖れは　瞬時に心に入り込む
us: Do not allow fear to take hold of your heart.

jp:
だが　支配を許すな
おまえの主人は　おまえ自身じゃ
us:
You are your own master, Nanaki─
you and no one else. Never forget that.

jp: 奥に見えておる扉をすべて越えれば　試験終了じゃ
us:
Look to the crevasse, and the gates beyond.
Pass through all to complete your trial.

jp: 心してかかるがよい
us: But that's easier said than done.

jp: どうやって開けんだ　これ？
us: So how're we s'posed to open this thing?

jp: さあナナキ　どうする？
us: How indeed. Ideas, Nanaki?

jp: 賢くなったのう　ナナキ
us: My, how resourceful you've become!

jp: この気配　忘れもせんぞ
us: I feel his presence... The villain.

jp: 我らが無念　いまこそ晴らさん！
us: Yes, come closer...that we may have our vengeance.

jp: 忌々しい裏切り者め！
us: A wretched betrayer walks among us!

jp: ここで消し去ってくれる！
us: Begone from this place!

jp: やった！
us: We beat them!

jp: さあ　どうだろうか
us: Have you now? In what sense?

jp: 彼らは亡霊　苦しみが消えることはない
us: They have yet to truly pass on, and their rage remains unquenched.

jp: 行くぞ　目的地はもうすぐそこじゃ
us: Come, let us keep pressing forward. We're very nearly there.

jp: あれ　また祭壇？
us: This reminds me of those altars...

jp:
ホーホウ　似ているが違う
もっともっと　ずっと古くに作られたものじゃ
us: There is a similarity, yes, but this sanctum is much more ancient, and serves a rather different purpose.

jp: 先の祭壇は　ギ族を封印するためのもの
us:
The altars we came upon before
were built to imprison the Gi.

jp:
この祭壇は　セトラが
ギ族と語り合うために作ったものじゃ
us:
This, however, was built to provide the Cetra
with a means to commune with them.

jp: 語り合うって　なんで？　ギ族は敵なんだよね
us: "Commune" with them? Why would the Cetra do that? The Gi were the enemy!

jp:
善悪や敵味方の区別など
時々の状況が　それを定義するに過ぎん
us: Good and evil, friend and foe...dichotomies not set in stone─as mutable as the winds.

jp:
さあ　ナナキ
おまえの力で道を切りひらくのじゃ
us: But for now, Nanaki, let us concentrate on the matter at hand─clearing a path to the truth.

jp: 泣いているの？
us: Sounds like crying...

jp:
ホーホーホウ……
悲しみもまた　絶えず姿を変えていく
us: As with good and evil, sorrow too assumes many forms.

jp:
４５年前　ひとりここまでやってきた戦士は
そのすべてを　一身に引き受けたのじゃ
us: Forty-five years ago, a Watcher fought his way here alone, and in his bravery took upon himself the burden of our hope.

jp: これは……
us: No...

jp: いかん　憎悪の気配
us: Their ire manifests once more.

jp: 気をつけるのじゃ　ナナキ！
us: Do not underestimate this foe!

jp: 怨念は　いまだ消えずか
us: Form evanescent, rancor everlasting...

jp: ナナキよ　強くなったのう
us:
Well done.
You've become quite the formidable fighter.

jp: へへ　まあね！
us: Sure have.

jp: 戦士の試験は　これで合格？
us: So, does this mean I passed the test?

jp:
ホーホウホウ！
わしひとりじゃ　決められんのう
us: I'm afraid that decision is not mine alone to make.

jp: あの戦士の意見も聞こうではないか
us: Let us consult with one more qualified.

jp:
戦士は　ひとりこの地で戦い　谷を守った
そしていまもここで　我々を守り続けている
us: The Watcher of the Vale fought valiantly, and offered up his life in defense of our home. As you see, he still watches over us─to this very day.

jp: じっちゃん　あれって
us: Wait... Is that...

jp:
あれが　セト？
オイラのチチ……
us: Seto? My father? ...No, there's no way.

jp:
毒矢で体は石になってしまったが
崩れることなく　欠けることなく　あの勇姿じゃ
us:
The poisoned arrows of the Gi transformed his body into stone, and there he has stood ever since,
his watch eternal─our savior.

jp: ハハは……母さんは知ってたの？
us:
What about my mom?
Did she know what had happened to him?

jp: ホーホウホウ　知っておったとも
us: Why, of course she did.

jp:
わしは　ふたりから
洞窟の封印を頼まれたんじゃ
us:
It was, after all, she and Seto who
asked me to seal off the cave.

jp: なんで……
us: But why?

jp: なんで　教えてくれなかったの！
us: Why did she never tell me the truth!?

jp:
教えたら　ひとりでここまで
会いにこようとしたのではないか？
us: Because she knew that if she did, you would attempt to seek your father out all by yourself.

jp:
おまえの両親が　もっとも守りたかったもの
それは　ほかならぬ
us: Your parents strove to keep our vale safe, but there is one thing they fought even harder to protect:

jp: おまえだよ　ナナキ
us: you, Nanaki─their son.

jp: オイラが　小さくて弱かったから？
us: She was afraid...because I was too small and weak.

jp: ホーホウホウ！

あの小さく　非力だったナナキが
こうして　立派な戦士に成長した
us: Back then, perhaps, but not anymore─heavens no. You've become a fine warrior in your own right.

jp: だから　ここへ連れてきたのじゃ
us: And that is precisely why I brought you here.

jp:
ナナキよ
おまえはこのまま　旅を続けなさい
us: But this is not where your journey is meant to end, my dear boy. You must leave the vale once more.

jp: オイラは谷の戦士だ！
us: But I'm a Watcher now!

jp: チチみたいに　これからずっとこの谷で
us: I gotta protect our home, like he did!

jp: 聞くのじゃ　ナナキ
us: Listen to me, Nanaki.

jp:
クラウドたちの言うことを
わしは信じようとしなかった
us:
When I first heard your friends' emphatic warnings,
I dismissed them outright.

jp: セミナーの連中がしそうな話だとな
us: No more than the ravings of misguided youths.

jp:
新しいものを見ても　聞いても
なーんか知ってるような気がしてのう
us: When you've lived as long as I have, you start to believe you've seen it all─that no surprises remain.

jp:
偉大な知見が含まれているかもしれん可能性を
わしのこの目は　見過ごすようになってしまった
us:
But I realize now how very foolish I have been.
The eyes that I thought saw the world clearly have grown blind to new possibilities.

jp: じっちゃん……
us: But...

jp: 若者たちの足を引っ張るのは嫌じゃ
us: I would hate to impede your progress any further.

jp:
行け　ナナキよ！
この谷で　ジジイ色に染まるな
us:
I bid you leave, Nanaki! Before, like me,
you become inured to your own ignorance.

jp:
目が曇り　耳も詰まってしまった
わしのかわりに世界を見てくるのじゃ！
us: With sharper eyes and keener ears go forth, and in my stead seek the great truths of our world!

jp: ナナキを頼む
us: Look after him for me.

jp: ああ　わかった
us: Don't worry. We will.

jp: 試験は不合格　修業を積んで出直してこい！
us:
You've failed this trial, my boy.
Continue your training, and try again!

jp: できるな？　ナナキ
us: Are you up to the task, Nanaki?

jp: もちろん　だって……
us: You bet I am. After all...

jp: オイラは　コスモキャニオンのナナキ！
us: I am Nanaki, Watcher of Cosmo Canyon...

jp: 戦士セトの息子だ！
us: and son of Seto...protector of our vale!

jp: 戦士の子よ
us: Hearken unto me.

jp: 我が名は　ギ・ナタタク
us: My name is Gi Nattak.

jp:
勇猛にして果敢な戦士セトよ
そなたの一族に　再び我らの願いを託したい
us: O brave and noble Seto... I beseech you once more... Hear the urgent pleas of my people.

jp: さすがセト　寛大な心に感謝する
us: My thanks, Seto. You are as magnanimous as ever.

jp: 戦士ナナキ　そして……
us: The warrior Nanaki. And you...

jp: セトラの民よ
us: the Cetra.

jp: ともに来てくれ
us: Come with me.

jp:
ホーホーホーーーウ！
面白いことになってきたのう
us: ...An exciting turn of events indeed.

jp: 報酬は２０００だな
us: We'll back you up for two thou.

jp: タダでいい　行くぞ
us: No. This one's free.

jp:
あやつは　ギ族の生霊じゃろう
ナナキを頼んだぞ
us: Within that Gi's flesh is a tumult of emotion. See to it that Nanaki remains safe.

jp:
ホーホーホウ！
見て聞いて触れて　世界を楽しむのじゃよ
us: ...Our world is filled with wonders. I bid you seek them out!

jp: ブーゲンハーゲン様は　我々が送り届けます
us: We will escort Fellow Bugenhagen back home.

jp: どうぞ　お気をつけて
us: Take care, friends.

jp: ナナキを　よろしくお願いいたします
us: Please look after Nanaki for us.

jp: ぜんっぜん状況がわかんないんだけど　これなに？
us: Ugh, can anyone explain to me why we're even taking this detour? Anyone?

jp:
アタシ　マテリアハンターなんだよね
ウータイのために戦ってるんだよね～
us: 'Cause some of us are on a mission to secure the materia we need to, you know, save our homeland.

jp:
ちょ～っと黙ってくれません？
てか　フツー怖がる状況とちゃいます
us: How can you talk like that in a place like this? I'm scared out of my wits here!

jp: だってなんか礼儀正しいじゃん　あのギ族
us: I dunno. This Gi dude's too nice to freak me out.

jp:
そういうのが　実はいちばん怖えんだ
気ぃ抜くなよ！
us: He may act nice, but who knows what he's planning. Stay alert.

jp: 我らの住み処へ案内したい
us: The home of the Gi lies beyond.

jp: さあ　お乗りください
us: Now let us begin our journey.

jp:
行ったら　なんかいいことある？
すんごいマテリアくれるとか
us:
Not so fast─what's in it for us?
Unless it's materia, you can count me out.

jp:
奇遇ですな
我々もマテリアを求めているのです
us:
How strange you should mention materia.
My people are also in search of it.

jp: さあ　乗って乗って！
us: Okay, all aboard!

jp: 行ってくるよ　父さん　じっちゃん
us:
Would've stayed longer if I could...
but I'll be back soon, I promise.

jp: 気持ち悪い……
us: I'm gonna hurl...

jp: 船の揺れに　体をあわせるといいよ
us: Maybe try swaying with the rocking of the boat?

jp: んな　器用なことできるか～
us: I wanna move less, not more...

jp: あんなに勢いよく乗り込んだのに
us: Didn't seem to mind when you jumped aboard.

jp: マテリアのためだもん
us: Only 'cause he mentioned materia...

jp: 静かに　星が聞いています
us: Be quiet. The planet is listening.

jp: 聞かれちゃ　まずいのか？
us: And what's wrong with that?

jp:
星が知ると　それはほどなく
セトラの耳に入るのですよ
us:
Anything that reaches the planet's ears,
in due time, reaches those of the Cetra.

jp: セトラは少々　寛容の精神に欠けますからね
us: Unfortunately, the Cetra are not a...tolerant people.

jp: わたし　セトラの末裔ですけど
us: Excuse me. Am I intolerant too? I'm Cetra.

jp: あなたが継承したのは　血だけのようだ
us: You are indeed one of them...by lineage alone.

jp: セトラの物語は　どこかに忘れてきましたね
us: You know not of their history. That has been lost to time.

jp: そうなの？
us: Their...history?

jp:
セトラの日々は過酷です
知らない方が長く生きられるでしょう
us:
Consider your ignorance a blessing.
The Cetra's past is fraught with horror and sorrow.

jp: 到着です
us: We've arrived.

jp: 負けるかあ～！
us: Hah! Still standing!

jp: ようこそ　ギ族の里へ
us: Welcome to the Village of the Gi.

jp: 星の民よ　よくぞ来た
us: Welcome to our domain, children of the planet.

jp: なんだ　いまのは！
us: Y'all hear that just now?

jp:
ギの意識は　肉体を無くしても
滅することがありません
us:
Our flesh is gone...
yet our spirits are condemned to linger.

jp:
よそ者の我らの意識を
星は受け入れてはくれないのです
us:
"Outsiders" such as we are unwelcome─
forever denied the planet's embrace.

jp: それは難儀なこった　同情するぜ
us: I feel for ya. Can only imagine how tough that's been.

jp: この像は体を無くした　ギの依り代
us: My kin now dwell within these effigies.

jp:
訴えに耳を傾けてやってください
彼らは　聞き手に飢えています
us:
I beseech you. Lend them your ears.
Long has it been since they have had an audience.

jp: よそ者のギ族を　星は受け入れてくれない
us:
They're not "bound" to the planet,
and so she rejects them.

jp: ライフストリームに帰れないんだね
us:
Because you have to come from
the lifestream to return to it.

jp: それって死なないってこと？　無敵じゃん！
us: Which means...these dudes can't die, right? They're invincible!

jp: 生きてるっちゅーワケでも　ないんでっしゃろ
us: I'm not sure that's somethin' to celebrate.

jp:
そんな中途ハンパな状態
死ぬより　苦しいんとちゃいます？
us:
Being stuck as spirits with no hope of release
sounds like a fate worse than death.

jp: 死んだことなんかないクセに
us: As if you know anything about dying.

jp: っていうか　あんた生きてるの？
us: I mean...are you even really alive?

jp: 中途半端は　ボクでっか～
us: Another stuck spirit perhaps?

jp: ギは　マテリアを求めたり
us: We shall not rest till the materia is ours.

jp: アタシもだよ
us: You and me both...

jp: 我らには　死も生もない
us: Cast out from the cycle of life and death...

jp: あるのは　永遠のみ
us: Into purgatory eternal...

jp: ギは　マテリアを求めたり
us: We shall not rest till the materia is ours.

jp: 星に受け入れられぬ我らのさだめ 我らは　我らを癒す道を探った
us: It was our fate to be spurned by the planet forevermore... Thus did we resolve to forge our own path to salvation.

jp: それが　マテリアなの？
us: With materia, you mean?

jp: ギは　癒しのマテリアを求めたり
us: We long to lay hands on the materia of peace.

jp: セトラは　我らを見捨てた
us: Forsaken by the Cetra...

jp: セトラは　我らを裏切った
us: Undone by treachery!

jp: ギは　癒しを求めたり
us: Salvation will be ours.

jp: マテリア…… それは　究極の癒しを我らに与える
us: There is but one thing that can deliver unto us ultimate salvation─and that is materia.

jp: 究極のマテリア！
us: So an ultimate materia!?

jp: どこ　どこにあんの？
us: Where is it!? Ya gotta tell me!

jp: ギは　究極の癒しをマテリアに求めたり
us: In the materia of peace, we shall find the end for which we have long yearned.

jp: 究極の癒し　すなわち　無 無に帰ることこそ　我々の悲願
us: Our ultimate salvation is cessation─it is nothingness. Our wish is not "to exist," but rather, to no longer exist.

jp: 無になることが　いやし？　ナニソレ
us: "Ultimate salvation is...nothingness"? Okay...

jp: ギは　無垢なるマテリアに願いを託したり
us: In the purest of materia, we placed our hope and faith.

jp: なんか　胸のあたりがザラッとするぜ
us: Dunno about y'all, but I got a sinkin' feelin'...

jp: あんまり　いい感じじゃねえな　ここは
us:
Think we probably don't wanna
overstay our welcome here.

jp: ギ族にとって　癒しは無になること
us:
It's hard to feel at ease around
folks whose only desire is death.

jp:
この星から消えるんが願い
せやなかったら　星ごと消す？
us:
And if the planet won't let them have it... Well,
who's to say they won't let the planet have it?

jp: こわっ！
us: Save me!

jp:
そのマテリア　アタシみたいに
しっかりした人が管理したほうが良くない？
us: Don'tcha think someone responsible like me oughta hang on to that materia? So it doesn't fall into the wrong hands?

jp: 関わらんほうが得策やと思いますけど
us: I think we shouldnae get involved at all, lassie.

jp: もう遅いようだな
us: Little late for that.

jp: オイラたちに　なにを頼む気なんだろう
us: Whaddya think he wants us to do for him?

jp: ギの願いは　無垢なるマテリアを黒く染め抜いた
us: Steeped in our one desire... Purest of materia no more... With pain and spite made black.

jp: ギの願いは──
us: Steeped in our one desire...

jp: 黒いマテリアかよ
us: Black materia, huh?

jp: このマテリアを　避けては通れないらしい
us: Whatever that materia is, we can't let them have it.

jp: あいつの言いなりにはならない
us: No matter how much they want it.

jp: どこまでだませるかわからないが　話を合わせよう
us:
Dunno how far we can let this go,
but for now, we play along.

jp:
我らギの故郷　我らの星は老いて力尽き
この星の一部となりました
us: With the passing of eons, the star we called home began to wane...until at last it was subsumed by your own.

jp:
空は割れ　大地は裂け
海は消え　時は乱れ
us: The earth shook, seas boiled, skies shattered, and time stopped.

jp:
その混乱を生きのびた　少数のギが
この星の住人となったのです
us: Few of my people survived the chaos and calamity. Those who did began a new life here.

jp: しかし星にとって　ギは異物でありました
us: But, to the planet, we were not welcome.

jp: 死してもなお異物
us: Not in life, nor in death.

jp:
星の意識　いわゆるライフストリームの中に
消え去ることは許されません
us: Those not born of the lifestream can never join its flow. One cannot "return" to that from which one did not arise.

jp: 星が見張る　この土地に縛りつけられ
us: And so, our souls sought refuge here.

jp:
生きることも　消えることも許されず
無為な時を過ごす苦行
us: Yet idleness brought no solace, our days a penance imposed by the planet for the sin of our existence.

jp:
この苦行から解放されることが
我々の悲願になりました
us: And now, our only wish is to be freed from this prison─to be granted true release.

jp:
我々は　星が育んだ無垢なるマテリアを手に入れ
一族の願いを注ぎ込んだのです
us:
From the planet, we claimed the greatest of
materia─a most sacred treasure─and imbued it
with our desire for freedom.

jp: 長いときの果て……
us: After an eternity...

jp:
マテリアは　ついに願いを受け入れ
我らは大いなる癒しのマテリアを手に入れました
us: the materia began to stir. And thus did we rejoice, knowing that salvation was within our grasp.

jp:
悲願が叶う　ついにその時が来たと
喜んだのも束の間のこと
us: We rejoiced, so convinced were we that our prayers for release had not been in vain.

jp:
憎きセトラがこの地に入り込み
我らの宝を奪い取ってしまったのです
us:
Yet the loathsome Cetra trespassed upon
our lands and stole the treasure that would
grant us deliverance.

jp:
我々は　その漆黒の宝珠を
『黒マテリア』と呼んでいます
us:
Therefore, we ask that you retrieve it─
the black materia, key to our oblivion.

jp:
どうか　黒マテリアを
我らの元に返していただきたい
us:
Please...
It alone can liberate us from this endless dream.

jp: それこそが　あなたがたに託したい我らの願い
us:
The Gi cannot rest until our sacred treasure
has been restored to us.

jp:
セトラの末裔が協力してくれるのであれば
長きわだかまりも消えてなくなるでしょう
us: Moreover, in redressing the crime of her ancestors, the Cetra may help us to let go our ancient grudge.

jp: 手がかりは？
us: Where is it?

jp:
黒マテリアは
セトラの神殿に隠されたと聞いています
us: It is said the orb lies within a place of Cetra worship.

jp: セトラ　古代種　神殿……
us: A place of Cetra worship...or temple.

jp: 知らねえか
us: Ya know one?

jp: あの　ボク　わかると思います
us:
I have an idea.
At least...I think I do.

jp: 虚ろなる者よ　信じてよいのですか
us: Forgive me, hollow one, if I regard you with suspicion.

jp: ヘイ・ユー！
us: Now hold on there!

jp:
みなさんの未来　占うで～！
明るいミライ　ゆかいなミライ
us:
I'm friend to one and all, thanks to my crystal ball.
No matter your need, I have the right read!

jp: こいつが言うなら大丈夫だ　信じていい
us: He's strange, but you can trust him. Really.

jp: うむ……
us: Hmm...

jp: どうやら　見つかってしまったようだ
us: Alas, it appears we have been discovered.

jp: 星の民よ　勇敢なる者たちよ
us: I trust you will return our materia to its rightful home.

jp: どうか　黒マテリアをこの地に
us: Only you can end our torment.

jp: あれ　帰ってきた
us: I...guess we're back?

jp: まず　地上に出よう
us: We need to get moving.

jp: りょーかい！
us: Right!

jp: 見ててよ　父さん
us: I'll make you proud, Dad. Just wait.

jp: 無事にお戻りになられましたね
us: It's good to see you again.

jp:
ブーゲンハーゲン様の元へ案内いたします
どうぞ　こちらへ
us: Allow me to escort you to Fellow Bugenhagen. Please, this way.

jp: キシシシシ！　うまくダマせたよね～
us: Heh heh heh. Hook, line, and sinker.

jp:
あのギ族の亡霊
アタシたちがマテリア持ってくると思ってるよ
us: Those undead suckers actually think we're gonna give 'em back their materia.

jp: 大いなる癒しとかなんとか言ってたが
us: They called it their "salvation" or whatever...

jp:
要するに　とんでもねえ威力の
おっそろしいマテリアってことだ
us: but to me, it sounded more like somethin' with the potential to wreak some serious havoc.

jp: ああ　ヤツらに渡すワケにはいかねえ
us: Nope. No way in hell are we lettin' them have it.

jp: あいつより　先に見つけないと
us: Can't let him have it, either.

jp: あいつって？
us: Him?

jp: セフィロスだ
us: Sephiroth.

jp: 気配を感じなかったのか？
us: Did no one else sense him?

jp: うん……
us: No.

jp:
セフィロスに関しちゃあ
おまえがそう言うなら　いたんだろうよ
us: You're the resident expert. If you say Sephiroth was there, I believe ya.

jp:
じゃあじゃあ　セフィロスも
黒マテリアを狙ってるってこと？
us: Wait, wait, wait. So, are you saying Sephiroth's after the black materia too?

jp: ああ　そう考えた方がいい
us: Prob'ly. Better to assume he is.

jp:
たいへん　こうしちゃいらんないよ
黒マテリアは　アタシが手に入れるんだから！
us: Well, c'mon. Let's go, let's go! Can't let anyone get between me and my materia!

jp:
ねえ　ケット・シー
セトラの神殿のこと　どうして知ってるの？
us: So, Cait Sith. I gotta ask...how do you know about this Cetra temple anyway?

jp: いや　え～っと……
us: Ah... Well, I...uh...

jp:
知ってるっちゅーか
心当たりがあるっちゅーか
us: I wouldnae say I know about it, exactly... Not directly, anyway...

jp: あ～ん？
