jp: ふむ　そうか
us: Hm, I see...

jp: 念のため　ほかの場所も確認するとしよう
us: But it's still too soon to draw any conclusions.

jp:
次は　この２箇所のライフスポットに
向かってみてくれるかの？
us:
Let's try another location, shall we?
We may yet get encouraging results.

jp:
わしは　頃合いを見計らって
おぬしらを追いかけるでの
us: Go on ahead; I will catch up to you when I am ready.

jp: たいへん　ライフスポットが襲われてるよ！
us: Oh no! Where did all these monsters come from!?

jp: 壊されちゃった……
us: What've they done to it?

jp: 急ごう　ほかの場所も心配だよ
us: C'mon! I'm worried about the other springs.

jp: ご苦労　ご苦労
us: That was excellent work.

jp: ここも　ダメかな～
us: Well, this doesn't look good.

jp:
１０……いや　４００か？
振れ幅が大きい
us: Ten... No─400? The meter's going crazy.

jp:
この　『Ｇｚ』という単位は
なんて読めばいいんだ
us: What's a "Gz" anyway? How do you even read this?

jp: 『ゲーゼル』　じっちゃんの名前だよ！
us: Gz stands for Geisel─his first name!

jp:
ライフストリームに一定の波があるのを
じっちゃんが最初に発見したんだ
us: Bugenhagen was the first person to discover that the lifestream emits energy we can measure.

jp: おっほん！
us: Oho!

jp: ……そんなことは　どうでもよい
us: But that's not worth mention.

jp:
さあ　まだまだライフスポットは残っておる
ぐずぐずしてると　日が暮れてしまうぞ
us: More importantly, our work remains unfinished! We'd best get on with it, while we still have the light.

jp:
これが　次の目的地の調査記録じゃ
引き続き　頼んだぞ
us: This is the site to which I would have you attend next. Good luck to you all, and safe travels.

jp: ライフスポット　守らなきゃ！
us: Hurry! We gotta protect the spring!

jp: じっちゃん　ごめ～ん
us: Man, we really blew it.

jp:
調査はうまくいかなかったようじゃの
まあ　仕方あるまい
us: That was an unfortunate turn of events. No matter, there are others.

jp: 終わったよ　じっちゃん！
us: It's safe to come down now!

jp: ホッホ　大手柄じゃ　ナナキ
us: ...Splendid job, Nanaki.

jp:
ふむ　力尽きる直前か
はたまた　目覚めの予兆か
us:
Hmm. It seems all but spent.
Or perhaps it is on the verge of awakening.

jp: これは……ウェポンの声に似てるね
us:
Wait... Is it just me,
or does that sound like a Weapon?

jp:
なるほどのう
であるならば　やはり……
us: Ah, yes. If that were the case, then maybe...?

jp:
さて　残りのライフスポットへ
先を急ぐとしよう
us:
Right, yes. We have not a moment to lose.
We must continue our work.

jp: 様子が変だ　気をつけて！
us: Something isn't right here. Be careful.

jp: 間に合わなかった……
us: We weren't fast enough.

jp: 落ち込んでおるヒマはないぞ　ナナキ
us: Pouting about it won't help anyone, Nanaki.

jp:
残すは　あとひとつじゃ
油断せぬようにな
us: Only one lifespring remains. You must focus.

jp: あれって……
us: No way...

jp: フィーラーか
us: Whispers?

jp: ホーウ　変わったお客人がいるようじゃの
us: Oh... We have been graced by curious guests.

jp:
じっちゃん
運命を支配する者がいるとしたら　信じる？
us: Hey, I was wondering...do you believe in fate? That something out there controls our future?

jp:
ホーホウ　運命など
あとから取ってつけたまやかしに過ぎん
us: Ohoho! "Fate" is a salve we use to soothe the sting of disappointment.

jp: いまをどう生きるかは　わしら次第じゃ
us: We are the masters of our lives, Nanaki.

jp: そうじゃろう　クラウド
us: Would you not agree, Cloud?
My my... Over seven thousand.

jp:
ふむ　かつてないほど
活性化しているようじゃな
us: Hmm... This is an unprecedented level of activity.

jp:
時の流れにつれ
ライフストリームの流れが変わったのか
us: Doubtless proof that the flow of the lifestream has shifted in some manner or another.

jp: あるいは……
us: The question is...

jp:
何者かにより　ねじ曲げられ
増幅されたのか
us: Was this shift natural, or was it the product of an external force?

jp: あれ　ここはモンスターがいないね
us: Weird... I don't see any monsters this time.

jp: ふむ　もう枯れてしまっておるようじゃの
us: Hmm... It appears that this site has gone fallow.

jp: クラウド　魔晄測定器をこちらへ
us: Cloud. The mako meter, if you would?

jp: ぬう　これは……！
us: Oh! My word!

jp: じっちゃん　さがってて！
us: We'll handle these guys! Get back!

jp: おぬしらがいてくれて　助かったわい
us: Perhaps I am getting too old for this.

jp: はあ　ホントだよ
us: ...My point exactly!

jp: おかげで　色々なことがわかった
us: I learned far more than I anticipated today.

jp:
おぬしらの言うように　どうやらいま
星には様々なことが起きているようじゃ
us: Though I harbored doubts, I now concede that you were right; something is happening to the planet.

jp:
まあ　調べられたのは
たったの２箇所じゃがのう
us: That said, two locations does not an ideal survey make.

jp:
原因がわからずじまいだったが　モンスターが
活性化しているのは　間違いないようじゃな
us: While the cause of the disturbance is unclear, there's no denying that the vale's fiends have become more violent.

jp: さて　なにについて話そうかの
us:
Many questions remain, but I can
share with you some answers.

jp:
ライフスポットとは元来　星の流れにあわせ
絶えず場所を変えていくもの
us: Lifesprings are fonts of mako, whose locations are dictated by the lifestream's ever-changing flow.

jp:
じゃが　これほどまでに短い周期で枯れ果てるなど
かつてなかったことじゃ
us: Yet in all my years, never have I seen a once-thriving spring wither in so short a time.

jp:
理由は定かではないが　星の命の営みはいま
急激な変化を迎えているようじゃな
us:
While still just a theory, given all I have witnessed,
I believe the planet is changing on an unprecedented scale.

jp:
ウェポンか……
古い文献に登場するから　その名は知っておった
us: Ah, the Weapons... I first learned of them from amusing fables in Cetran tomes.

jp:
だが　なにかの象徴　たとえであって
実在するとは考えていなかった
us:
Quite frankly, I did not believe they existed.
I thought them merely allegorical.

jp:
だから　おまえたちの目撃談も
即座に否定してしまったというわけじゃ
us: Thus did I dismiss the tales of your encounters with these incredible creatures.

jp:
いや……違うな
わしは　恐れていたのじゃ
us: No, that's not it. In truth I was terrified.

jp:
星の危機に生まれるというウェポンの存在
ひいては　この星の行く末を受け止めることを
us: Weapons are born into existence when the planet is in crisis. When the survival of all creation is at stake.

jp:
おぬしらの訴えを邪険にあつかったこと
あらためて詫びよう　このとおりじゃ
us: I hope you will forgive me my discourteousness. You came to me in good faith, and I turned you away.

jp: 恐怖に向き合わねば　恐怖を克服することはできん
us:
But we must face our fears.
Only then can we hope to overcome them.

jp:
ウェポンの予兆　わしも真実として
受け止めねばならぬ時がきたようじゃ
us:
And so I face mine. The Weapons have come,
and they portend a grim future for us all.

jp: ライフスポットにただよう　邪悪な気配
us: A malevolent energy descended upon that lifespring.

jp:
どうやら　星命学の領域では計り知れない
なにかが起きているようじゃ
us: Never in all my years of planetological research have I ever seen such a disturbing phenomenon.

jp: おぬしらは　なんぞ心当たりがあるようじゃの
us:
You, however, appeared unfazed
by what you witnessed.

jp: うん……
us: Yeah...

jp:
ホーホウホウ！
ナナキよ　それでよい
us:
Ohoho...
You needn't explain, Nanaki.

jp:
憶測で物事を語り始めれば
真実を見る目は失われ　やがては道を誤る
us:
Indeed, it may be best that you do not.
The experiences of others may skew our own perception of the truth.

jp:
あれについては　いましばらく
観察が必要そうじゃのう
us: For the time being, quiet observation is key to unraveling this mystery.

jp:
いずれにしても偉大な星に対し　我々ひとりの人間
ひとつの命ができることなど　ないに等しい
us: In the grand scheme of both the planet and the lifestream, the lives of us mortals, and the sublunary parts we play, are undeniably inconsequential.

jp:
星とは　これまでこの星に生きた
幾億もの命　そのすべてだからのう
us: For our world is the accumulation of trillions of souls─an assemblage of all life that ever was, and will ever be.

jp:
しかしそれは同時に　星もひとりひとりの人間
ひとつひとつの命の集合体だということでもある
us: But that is far too reductive a way to view the cycle which sustains us. We are, after all, a part of the planet─and the planet is a part of us too.

jp:
小さな波紋も　広がり　響きあえば
やがて大きな力となるじゃろう
us: We mustn't forget that even the smallest of ripples can gather the strength to become the greatest of waves.

jp:
まずは　己にできること
成し遂げるべきことに　全力を注ぐことじゃ
us: It is thus incumbent upon us to do all we can in the time we are allotted─to not die a ripple.

jp:
わしも今いちど　全力でこの星と向き合うとしよう
なにかわかれば　おぬしらにも伝えるでの
us: I endeavor to do just that. I will continue to work to uncover the planet's secrets─and if I find anything, I will let you know.

jp:
うん　無理はしないでね
じっちゃん
us: Alright. Just...try not to overdo it─for me?

jp: ホーホー　ホホホーウ！
us: Ohoho!

jp: おっと　こんなときに誰かのう
us: Oh...? Now who could this be?

jp: 見張り番からのようじゃ　なになに……
us:
Why, it's from a watchman in town...
How odd.

jp: むむ　なんということじゃ！
us: Oh! What did you say!?

jp: どうしたの　じっちゃん
us: Is something wrong?

jp:
谷を巡回していた調査隊から
ギ族の亡霊を目撃したと報告があったそうじゃ
us: I fear there is. The survey team has returned with reports of sightings of Gi spirits within the vale.

jp: 洞窟は　封印したんだよね
us: But they were sealed within the cave!

jp: した　この目で確認したぞ
us: Indeed they were! I can attest to that.

jp: それなら　どうして
us: So how did they get out!?

jp:
なにしろ　相手は亡霊じゃ
わしらの理屈では計りしれん
us:
Well, these are spirits, Nanaki.
Who knows what they can or cannot do.

jp: ナナキと仲間たちよ　力を貸してくれ
us:
Though I know this is sudden,
will you lend us your aid?

jp:
詳しい話は見張り番に
わしも谷へ戻るとしよう
us:
Go and speak to the watchman at the gate.
I will return to the vale on my own.

jp: 見張り番の元へは　もう行ったのか？
us: Have you spoken with the watchman at the village gate yet?

jp:
ううむ　いったいいつ
どうやって谷から抜け出したのか
us: Hmm... Just when and how did they manage to escape their immurement?

jp: 亡霊の一件　頼んだぞ
us: I trust you will see to the Gi spirits.

jp:
おお　来ておったか
その後　なにか面白い発見はあったかのう
us: Ah, you've returned. Have you made any eye-opening discoveries in your travels?

jp: 世界を見て　聞いて　触れて
us: Do not simply observe─experience!

jp:
どんな物事も　なにかの大きな糧となる
そんな出会いが見つかるとよいな
us: Every moment is an opportunity to learn and grow, and become the people we were meant to be.

jp: なにやら　世間が慌ただしくなってきたようだのう
us: A single broadcast is all that it takes to turn the world upside down.

jp:
強すぎる欲はゆがみを招く
神羅と戦争は切っても切れんものなのじゃろう
us: Greed has ever been a gateway to all manner of sin. Though I suppose at this point, Shinra and war go hand in hand.

jp: ああ　ナナキ！
us: Oh good, Nanaki!

jp:
調査隊が　谷の外で
ギ族の亡霊を目撃したらしいんだ
us: We just got word from the survey team that they spotted the Gi right outside of town.

jp:
じっちゃんから聞いた
調査隊の人たちは無事なの？
us:
Yeah, I heard. Are they okay?
They weren't attacked, were they?

jp:
ああ　たまたま谷に繋がる昇降機の近くにいてね
車はそのまま乗り捨ててきたらしいが
us: Don't worry, everybody's fine. Happened to be near the elevator, so they were able to escape in time. Though they had to leave their truck behind, unfortunately.

jp:
オイラ　行ってくるよ
谷が襲われたら　大変だ！
us:
Okay, I'll go take a look.
We can't let more into the vale!

jp: 頼む　でも気をつけるんだぞ
us: 'Preciate it. Just...be careful out there.

jp:
調査隊がギ族を目撃したのは
昇降機でおりた　谷底あたりらしい
us: The survey team folks were saying they saw the Gi specters below, in the bed of the canyon near the elevator.

jp: 気をつけて行けよ
us: Take care out there.

jp: こんなこと　長いことなかったのにな
us: Been so long since we saw any... Why now?

jp: あそこだ　急ごう！
us: That's the place. Come on!

jp: この気配　セトか？
us: 'Tis him... Seto.

jp: 違うよ　オイラは
us: What? I'm not Seto. I'm...

jp: 憎きセト　裏切り者のセト！
us: Loathsome wretch. You think we shall be fooled again!?

jp: 積年の恨み　思い知らせてくれる
us:
Undying is our enmity.
Here we shall have our revenge!

jp: ぐっ　このまま終わらせはせぬぞ
us: Grr... We will not be denied!

jp: どうする
us: What now?

jp: 追いかけよう
us: We follow 'em!

jp:
ほう　ちょうど良い
ここで沈めてくれるわ！
us:
Hmph. Perfect...
This place shall be your grave.

jp: ……やはり力が足りぬか
us: Such vessels cannot contain our fury.

jp:
おお　力がみなぎる……
先ほどのようには行かぬぞ　セト！
us: Such power, now ours to command! You are no match for us this time, Seto!

jp: おのれ　忌々しい……
us: Wretched cur... This is far from over.

jp: 待って　あんたたち誤解してるよ
us: Whoa, hey! Hang on! You guys have it all wrong!

jp: 黙れ　セト！
us: Silence, Seto!

jp:
黒マテリア奪還の悲願を果たさんと
我々は　おまえに助けを請うた
us: We beseeched your aid─begged you to recover the black materia. You would bring us salvation.

jp: ええっ　それいつの話？
us: Huh? What!? I never agreed to that!

jp: とぼけるな　セト！
us: Do not feign ignorance, Seto!

jp: おのれ　セトめ……
us: Curse you, foul Seto!

jp: オイラはセトじゃない　ナナキだ
us: I'm not Seto. I'm his son, Nanaki.

jp:
ねえ　ちゃんと聞かせてよ
セト……オイラのチチと　ギ族の話を
us:
There's a lot of things I don't know yet, but
I want to learn. Can you teach me about my father? About you?

jp:
おまえは……そうか
セトではなく　セトの子――
us:
Your...father... I see... As you wish, son of Seto.
What would you like to know?

jp:
セトはあの日　ひとりであの洞窟へとやってきた
攻め入る我らを説得しようとな
us: Seto ventured deep into the caverns below your home that day, alone, that he might persuade us to cease our ingress.

jp:
奴とまみえたのはそれが初めてであったが
見事なたてがみを持つ　美しい獣であった
us: Though we had braced ourselves for battle, we found ourselves captivated by his resplendent mane. He was a beautiful creature in both body and soul.

jp:
我らはセトの勇気と誠意を認め
我らの悲願を託すことにしたのだ
us: So swayed were we by his courage and sincerity that we chose to entrust with him our singular desire.

jp:
我らの願いは
黒マテリアを取り戻し　消えること
us: We desire the return of our black materia and deliverance from this purgatory.

jp:
だが　それを告げた途端
セトは手のひらを返した
us: We believed Seto to be a man of his word─yet his betrayal proved otherwise.

jp:
セトの裏切りに
我らは嘆き悲しみ　怒りをたぎらせた
us: Our hopes placed in him, only to be trampled upon... We were forsaken, overcome with rage.

jp:
荒れ狂う我らの矢をその身に受けながら
セトは　我らに言い放った
us: One by one, our arrows found their mark, yet Seto was unfazed by our assault.

jp:
話であれば　いつでも聞こう
矢を射たくば　いくらでも受けよう
us: As a confidant, our secrets he would keep. As a penitent, our vengeance he would accept.

jp: だが　決して谷に攻め入らせはせんと
us: Yet Seto would not forsake his duty to keep us from the vale.

jp: セトの決意は　揺るがなかった
us: He was resolute. His will adamantine.

jp:
毒が全身にまわり　体が石になり果ててもなお
かたくなに我らの猛攻をはばみ続けた
us: And with every arrow that struck, his body hardened to match his resolve before our very eyes─unmoving in the face of our relentless onslaught.

jp:
やがて　我らは絶望に力尽き
再び暗き地の底に沈み　よどんだ
us: 'Twas not long until we lost heart, conceding the futility of our plight, and sank back into the dark depths whence we came.

jp:
消えることも叶わず
さりとて慰められることもなく
us: Yet the darkness granted us no comfort, and certainly not the oblivion for which we so desperately yearn.

jp:
ねえ　チチが……セトができなかったこと
オイラに引き継がせてくれないかな
us: I...I know this might sound hard to believe, but I want to finish what my father started. I want to fulfill his promise to you.

jp: うーむ……
us: Is that so?

jp:
ギ・ナタタクにも頼まれたんだ
黒マテリアを　取り戻してほしいって
us:
And even if you don't trust me, Gi Nattak does.
He asked me to get back your materia.

jp:
オイラ　ギ族のみんなが
安らかに眠れる方法を探す
us: Like I told him, I'll do everything I can to make sure you can rest in peace.

jp: だから　それまで洞窟で待っててほしいんだ
us: All I ask is that you wait in your cave until I return.

jp: その言葉　嘘ではあるまいな
us: And if we comply...you will keep your word?

jp: すこし　時間はかかるかもしれないけどね
us: It might take some time, but I'll do it.

jp: うむ……
us: Very well.

jp: おお　ついに　ついに……
us: Finally...at long last!

jp:
約束　たがえるでないぞ
セトの息子　ナナキよ
us:
And thus, the promise has been made.
See that it is not broken, son of Seto.

jp: いいのか　連中は忘れないぞ
us: You sure about this? They're gonna hold you to it.

jp: チチは　わかってたんだ
us: And I hope they do.

jp:
星に帰れないギ族の苦しみも……
ギ族に黒マテリアを渡しちゃダメだってことも
us: Dad understood the Gi's suffering, but he also understood others would suffer if the Gi ever got the materia back.

jp:
だから　自分の体が石にされようとも
ギ族の怒りを　たったひとりで受け止めた
us: He was willing to bear that pain for them─even if it turned him to stone─if it meant that he could spare others from their wrath.

jp: 黒マテリアは　必ずオイラたちで見つけ出す
us: We just have to find that black materia.

jp: でも　絶対に誰にも　ギ族にも渡さない
us: And we have to make sure that no one gets their hands on it─not the Gi or anyone else.

jp:
そのかわり　オイラはこの旅で
ギ族を救う方法を見つけるよ
us: But I do wanna keep my promise. I'm gonna find a way to release them from their suffering.

jp:
世界の色んなものを見て　聞いて　触れて
必ず……！
us: There's gotta be an answer out there somewhere, and I'm not gonna stop searching until I find it.

jp:
ホーホーホウ！
それでこそ　谷の戦士じゃ
us: Ohoho...! Spoken like a true Watcher.

jp: 願う力は　人を強くする
us: Our hopes and our dreams give us strength.

jp:
ナナキよ
いまのその気持ち　決して忘れるでないぞ
us:
Remember that. Hold tight to yours,
and see that you never let them go.

jp: さすれば　おのずと答えは見つかるはずじゃ
us: In time, they shall lead you to the answer you seek.

jp: うん！

ホーホウ
これで調査隊も巡回に戻れそうじゃな
us: Ohoho... I suppose the survey team can now resume their expedition.

jp:
久しぶりにあちこち出歩いて疲れたわい
そろそろ戻るとするかのう
us: Long has it been since I've spent this much time out and about. I'd best head home and rest these bones.

jp:
ブーゲンハーゲン様から聞いたよ
ギ族は無事　封印できたようだね
us: Fellow Bugenhagen told us everything. About how you dealt with the Gi─saw them sealed again.

jp:
調査隊の巡回も　じきに再開するそうだ
ありがとうな
us: That means the survey team should be able to start doing their rounds again. Thanks.

jp:
ようこそ
星命学の聖地　コスモキャニオンへ
us: Welcome to Cosmo Canyon, the birthplace of planetology.

jp: 星について　しっかり学んでくれ
us: We have plenty of seminars to choose from here.

jp: やあ　コスモキャニオンにようこそ
us: Hey! Welcome to Cosmo Canyon.

jp:
ナナキの友達に
星の加護がありますように
us: May the blessings of the planet be upon you all, friends of Nanaki.

jp:
最近　谷を訪れる人が増えていてね
厄介事が起きないといいんだが
us: I don't know what it is, but we've seen a lot more tourists lately. I just hope they don't cause any trouble.

jp: コスモキャニオンへ　ようこそ
us: Welcome to Cosmo Canyon.

jp: ここは風と魂の集う場所なのです
us: Here souls gather from far and wide.

jp:
あなたも　谷に
吹き寄せられてきたのですね
us: The planet has guided you here as well, hasn't it?

jp:
私たちはみな
星の導きの元にあるのです
us: We are here by the grace of the planet─our guiding light.

jp: 我々は　あなたの訪れを歓迎します
us: We welcome you to our vale with open hearts.

jp:
星とともに生きることこそ
私たちの喜びなのです
us: Each day we share with our great mother is a day for celebration.

jp:
この星に生きるものは
みな　兄弟です
us: All born of the planet are kin, without exception.

jp: 星は我々にすべてを与えてくれます
us: Everything we have is a gift given to us by the planet.

jp: あなたに星の祝福を……
us: May the planet watch over and keep you...

jp:
母さんも　ランタンといっしょに
星に帰ったのかな
us: I want to believe those lanterns helped guide Mom home to the planet.

jp: 谷は　あなたたちを歓迎するわ
us: You are more than welcome here in the canyon.

jp: 離れがたいな　コスモキャニオン
us: Finding it hard to leave? I feel that.

jp:
俺もこの風に乗って
どこか遠くに行きたい
us: If only I, too, could ride the wind and travel the world.

jp: 星のパワーを感じるよな　なあ？
us: Can you feel it too? The planet's power?

jp:
ここに住んだら毎日
星に祈れるのか
us: Might be nice to live among people who revere the planet as much as I do.

jp: ここに来るまえとは別人になった気分
us: This place's changed me. For the better, I think.

jp: コスモキャニオン　魂のふるさとね
us: There's something so...spiritual about Cosmo Canyon.

jp: 来年の星送りも　いまから楽しみ～！
us: I'm already looking forward to coming back for next year's ceremony!

jp: ここは人生でいちどは来るべき場所ね
us: I think everyone should come here at least once in their lives.

jp:
反神羅連絡会って
星命学とは関係ないよな？
us: The folks here aren't involved with the SRC or anything...are they?

jp:
ここにいれば
星が守ってくれんじゃねえか？
us: No matter what happens, the planet will keep us safe.

jp:
あなたとの出会いを
星に感謝します
us: I give thanks to the planet for this blessed meeting.

jp:
アバランチってのは
コスモキャニオンが発祥なんだろ？
us: Apparently Avalanche was founded here in Cosmo Canyon.

jp:
戦争で失われた命も
星に帰るんだよな？
us: All those souls lost to war will return to the planet too...right?

jp:
争いは無意味だって
セミナーで言ってたぜ
us: Everyone at the seminar agreed that war is just pointless.

jp:
戦争なんて……
ここにいると現実味がないわ
us: There's war brewing out there? Huh... Looking around this place, you'd have no idea.

jp:
世の中　負のエネルギーが
ありあまってるのかもね
us: The world might have too much negative energy floating around in it.

jp:
精神エネルギーってやつで
戦争も止められたらいいのに
us: You think we could, I dunno, use spiritual energy to put an end to war?

jp:
星は戦争からも
私たちを守ってくれるのかしら
us: The planet will protect us from the ravages of war, right? Why wouldn't it?

jp:
星を大切にしようと思ったら
戦争する気なんか起きないはずよね
us: If we wish to take good care of the planet, we should avoid war at all costs, right?

jp:
黒衣の旅人……
いったい　どこからやってくるのか
us: Another wanderer in black robes... Where are they all coming from?

jp:
星よ　どうか
かの者に救いの道を
us: O great planet, guide this lost soul back into your light...

jp: この谷は　いろんな魂を引き寄せるのよ
us: Our vale draws in people from all walks of life.

jp: えっなに　ケガ人？
us: What's goin' on? Is somebody hurt?

jp: 黒マントだってよ
us: You see that robe?

jp: 黒マント……こんなところにまで
us: But...how did one of them make it all the way up here?

jp: あのひと　大丈夫なの？
us: What happened? Is he okay?

jp:
黒マントって
なんかの病気って聞いたけど
us: I heard the people in black robes are suffering from some sort of illness.

jp: きっともう長くはないわね……
us: They probably don't have much time left.

jp: 谷の見張り　ご苦労さまです
us: Thanks for keeping watch over the vale.

jp:
調査隊のみなさん
これから巡回ですか？
us: My pleasure! Are you about to head out on patrol?

jp: ええ　留守のあいだ谷を頼みます
us: Yeah. Look after this place while we're gone.

jp:
はい　みなさんもお気をつけて
星の加護があらんことを！
us: I will. You be careful out there! And may the planet keep you safe.

jp:
旅人も　星がもたらしてくれる
大切な恵みなの
us: Travelers are one of many blessings that are granted to us by the planet.

jp: みなさん　ご無事でなによりでした
us: I'm so glad you all made it out of there okay.

jp:
まさか　あんな場所で
ギ族と出くわすとは
us: Me too. I didn't think we'd run into the Gi...

jp:
なにか　強い憎しみや悲しみに
囚われているように見えたが
us: It seemed like they were bound by a deep hatred or sadness.

jp:
いったい　なにが
起きているのでしょうか
us: There must be a reason for this, but what?

jp:
例のギ族の件
ナナキが解決してくれたそうですね
us: Sounds like Nanaki took care of those Gi. They won't be a problem anymore.

jp: ああ　さすがは谷の戦士だ
us: Indeed. He's a true Watcher.

jp:
我々もいまいちど　気を引き締めて
巡回にあたるとするよ
us: I suppose that means it's about time we resumed our patrols, then.

jp:
はい　みなさんに
星の加護があらんことを！
us: Of course. May the planet watch over you and keep you safe!

jp:
星とともに生きなさい
星は我らであり　我らもまた星である
us: We must live in harmony with our great mother, for the planet is an extension of us─and we of it.

jp:
すべての恵みは星によってもたらされ
すべての命は星へと帰りゆく
us: As such, the life with which she has blessed us is a gift that must one day be returned.

jp: みんな　同じ星に生きる家族よ
us: All who call this planet home are family.

jp:
己の命をはぐくむことは
星の命をはぐくむこと
人々よ　学びなさい　祈りなさい
us: To nurture your spirit is to nurture the spirit of the planet. And so I implore you, brothers and sisters: do not neglect your studies, nor your prayers!

jp: その果てにこそ　至上の幸福は訪れる
us: Through your diligence, you will find true fulfillment.

jp: 与える喜びを知りなさい
us: Learn well the joys of giving.

jp:
惜しみなく与える者にこそ
星は祝福をもって応えてくださる
us: Generosity is a great virtue─one which the planet will reward in kind.

jp: 喪失を恐れることはない
us: We are not made lesser for it.

jp:
去ったものは星を巡り
やがて再び　我らの元へともたらされる
us: Our world is sustained by an unending cycle. All that passes from us shall one day return.

jp: 与える者は　決して奪われないのだ
us: Those who sacrifice shall be made whole.

jp: 我らは同じ星から生まれし兄弟
us: We are siblings all, born of one mother.

jp:
母なる星は　我らすべての子を愛し
育んでくださる
us: With boundless love for her children, she serves as both cradle and crucible.

jp:
母の元へ帰るその日まで我らは旅を続け
磨きあげた魂の輝きをもって
母なる星を癒すのです
us: When our journey ends and our return is ordained, we go as beings honed by lives well lived─a balm to the planet that ensures the cycle continues.

jp:
母のため　兄弟のため
我々は喜んでこの身を捧げましょう
us: It is for our mother─and for our brothers and sisters─that we render up our bodies and our souls.

jp:
生きるということは
星とともに歩むことなのです
us: Our joy, our sorrows─they are the planet's too.

jp: 母なる星を信じなさい
us: Put your faith in our great mother.

jp:
星は　星の子である我らを
決して見捨てることはありません
us: She would never forsake us, never abandon us, for we are her children one and all.

jp:
星は　いつでも我らを守り
災いから遠ざけてくださる
us: This wonderful planet is always watching over us─ever keeping calamity at bay.

jp:
感謝の心を忘れず
星に祈りを捧げる限り
我々が飢えに苦しむことはないのです
us: If people everywhere resolved to not take her bounty for granted─and offered up prayers of gratitude─no man, woman, or child would suffer.

jp: 星の声に耳を傾けなさい
us: Hearken to the wisdom of the planet.

jp:
我々が星に寄り添うとき
星は惜しみなく
その知識を分け与えてくださる
us: It is boundless and infinite, and we may share in it freely if we open ourselves to her.

jp:
知識とは命そのもの
土も木も鳥も
星の知識のひとつのかたち
us: It is found within the soil beneath our feet, the trees from which it sprouts, the birds which nestle in their boughs.

jp:
そして　かたちを失ったとき
すべてはまた知の源泉となり
星を巡るのです
us: And when that life fades, it returns to the wellspring of all truths that is the beating heart of our mother.

jp:
我らに恐れるべきものがあるとすれば
それは同じ星に生きる隣人ではない
us: If we've anything to fear, it is not our fellow man─nor any creature, big or small, with whom we share our home.

jp:
星のわだちの外より来たる
異なるもの
us: It is that which comes from beyond the confines of this world.

jp:
星は常に　私たちを
見守ってくれているわ
us: The planet is always watching over each and every one of us.

jp:
かの者は星のことわりを乱し
いずれは　星を食い尽くすであろう
us: That which disrupts the natural order─the other which may attempt to claim and consume the planet.

jp: 星の子らよ　手をとり団結しなさい
us: And so I bid you, her children, to join hands and come together.

jp:
かの者に
おびやかされることのないように
us: For united, we shall never succumb to fear of celestial calamity.

jp:
あなたは内なる星　内なる宇宙と
向きあったことがありますか？
us: I ask you this: who among you has looked inward, into the universe of the soul?

jp:
我々は星の一部であり
星もまた我々の一部
us: Just as each of us is a part of the planet, the planet is a part of us.

jp:
内なる声に耳を傾けることは
星の声に耳を傾けることでもあるのです
us: Therefore, does it not follow that to heed the words of one's own heart, is in essence to heed the words of our great mother?

jp:
さあ　ともに星の声を
聞いてみませんか？
us: Thus do I urge you to hearken to that voice─that of the planet.

jp:
あなたの中に眠る星の意識
かつての記憶……
us: Within you all are the planet's thoughts and memories.

jp:
それらを語り　共有することで
精神エネルギーの質はより高まってゆく
us: By unlocking this knowledge, it allows us to heighten our spiritual potency.

jp:
さあ　いまこそ己を解き放つとき
大いに語りあい　高めあいましょう
us: I invite you to do so now! Set free the secrets within, and lift yourselves higher!

jp: 星を巡る精神エネルギー
us: Feel the energy all around you.

jp: 星とともにある幸福に感謝を
us: Every day I give thanks to the planet.

jp:
その力は風とともにこの谷へ流れ込み
呼吸を通じて我々の体に取り込まれます
us: It rides the winds across our planet, singing through the vale to fill our lungs, and by extension our very beings.

jp:
これぞ星の神秘　みなさんに
谷に伝わる呼吸法をお教えしましょう
us: As you'll come to learn, the practice of mindful breathing can connect us with the ineffable wonders of the planet.

jp:
この谷は　いにしえより
星のエネルギーが満ちる土地
us: Since time immemorial, these sacred lands have been rich in spiritual energy.

jp:
吹き抜ける風に従い谷を巡ることは
星に生き　星に帰り
us: To pass through the vale, and trace the whistling winds, is to reflect on the journey of life and our eventual return.

jp:
そしてまた　この星に
生まれ直すことと同義なのです
us: It is to understand the cycle that sustains us─the cycle of death and rebirth.

jp:
さあ　あなたも星の導きに従い
ともに星を巡りましょう
us: Go forth, brothers and sisters. Lend an ear to the winds, and walk the path of discovery.

jp:
あら坊や　お手伝いかい？
いい子にはごほうびをあげましょうね
us: What an upstanding young man you are, helping out like this. You deserve a nice reward.

jp:
ありがとう！　ハハさま見て
アメをもらったよ
us: Thank you so much! Mom, look! I got some candy!

jp:
まあ　ありがとうございます
きちんとお祈りしてからいただくのよ？
us: Oh, that's very kind! Thank you. Remember to say a prayer before you eat it!

jp: わかってるよ
us: I know.

jp: あなたも星に導かれましたか
us: Let me guess─the planet led you here?

jp:
『母なる星よ
　今日も恵みに感謝します』
us: O great mother planet, thank you for this blessing.

jp: はい　よく言えましたね
us: That's my good little boy.

jp:
こんにちは
これからおでかけ？
us: Oh, hello. Heading out somewhere?

jp:
ええ　お供え物の準備があって
今年は豊作でありがたいかぎりね
us: Yes, actually. Wanted to make an offering to the planet. We had such a great harvest this year, I thought it only proper.

jp: そっちは　おなかの子はどう？
us: But enough about me. How are you doing?

jp:
とっても順調よ　星のエネルギーが日々
おなかに流れ込んでくるのを感じるの
us: I'm fine, thank you. Baby's well too. I feel her getting stronger and stronger with every passing day.

jp:
すべては星のお恵みね
感謝しなくっちゃ
us: We've all been so blessed, haven't we? Praise be to our great mother.

jp:
ブーゲンのじいさま
今日は　おりてくるかな？
us: Hey, is Fellow Bugenhagen gonna come down today?

jp:
どうかな　このまえは
お腰が痛いって言ってたし
us: Hmm, I dunno. The other day he said his back was hurting a lot.

jp:
おりてくれば
俺たちでさすってやれるのにな
us: Well, then he oughta come down and...get a massage!

jp:
チチさまが
これからブーゲンのじいさまに
食べ物を届けに行くって言ってたよ
us: Oh, y'know what? My daddy said he was gonna go deliver Fellow Bugenhagen some food!

jp:
旅の若者よ
星の声に耳を傾けなさい
us: Welcome, young traveler. Open your ears and hearken to the voice of the planet.

jp: いっしょに　ついてってみる？
us: Maybe we could go with him?

jp:
さっき　ナナキの姿を見かけたの
元気そうで安心したわ
us: Can you believe it? Nanaki's back! It's such a relief to know that he's okay.

jp:
でも　あの目の傷……
いったい外でどんな酷い思いをしたのか
us: Did you see that scar over his eye, though? I don't know what he's been through, but it must've been bad.

jp:
それでもこうして谷に帰ってこれた
いまは　そのことを星に感謝しましょう
us: Still, he's home safe now, and we owe the planet a debt of gratitude for that. We should make an offering.

jp:
『反神羅組織アバランチ』か……
彼らもすっかり有名になってしまったね
us: "Avalanche, wanted dead or alive"... They've certainly made a name for themselves, haven't they?

jp: 悠長なことを言ってる場合？
us: For themselves and for us.

jp:
世間から見れば　星命学もアバランチも
同じようなものなのよ？
us: In the public's eyes, planetologists and Avalanche are one and the same.

jp:
う～ん　神羅もいきなり
谷を攻撃するなんてことはないと思うが
us: Even so, I doubt we need to worry about Shinra up and attacking Cosmo Canyon unprovoked.

jp: 研究が続けられなくなるのは困るな
us: Though that would complicate my research.

jp: あの風車は谷の発電機
us: That windmill generates energy for us.

jp:
我々はいつか　星に帰る日のために
生きているのだ
us: Life is a wondrous gift from the planet─one that is precious and fleeting.

jp:
魔晄炉と比べれば
つくられる電力はわずかなものですが
我々には　それでじゅうぶん
us: Its output pales in comparison to that of a mako reactor, but it's more than enough for the people of the vale.

jp:
とれた穀物を製粉したり
調査隊の車の動力に利用したり
us: It allows us to mill grain and power our survey teams' vehicles, among other things.

jp:
その日に必要なぶんだけ
風の力を分けていただいています
us: Every day, the amount produced gets divvied up to satisfy all our needs.

jp:
星の恵みたっぷり
コスモソルトをひとふりかければ
どんな野菜もごちそうだよ！
us: With Cosmo salt, you can add a dash of the planet's grace─and deliciousness─to anything you like!

jp:
太古の記憶を呼びさますコスモソルト
さあ　おひとついかがかな？
us: Blessings of the planet be upon your cooking with our one-of-a-kind seasoning!

jp: さあ　ご注目！
us: Step right up, folks!

jp:
遺跡から掘り出されたばかりの
正真正銘の掘り出しモノだよ～！
us: We've got top-quality antiques at prices that can't be beat, no sir!

jp:
遺物との出会いは一期一会
これも　星のお導きですよ！
us: The planet guided you to our store─so don't miss out on these incredible deals!

jp:
生きとし生けるもの
すべては星から生まれた兄弟なのです
us: All creatures great and small are given life by the planet. All are brothers and sisters.

jp: さあさ　見てってお客さん
us: Have a look around! C'mon!

jp:
ルビーコーンにコスモサボテン
ここでしか買えない谷の特産品だよ
us: You won't find ruby cones or Cosmo cactuars anywhere but here! Better not miss out!

jp: 星の恵みに感謝しようじゃないか！
us: Show your gratitude for the planet's gifts!

jp:
星の力を引き寄せる
『星守り』はいかが？
us: Come get a talisman infused with the powers of the planet!

jp:
星を巡る祖先の魂が　きっと
あなたに幸運をもたらしてくれるわよ
us: Buy one of these, and the souls of our ancestors will surely grant you good fortune!

jp:
谷に伝わる『星降織』で
作ったバッグよ
us: These bags were made with our one-of-a-kind weaving technique!

jp:
織り込まれた模様のひとつひとつに
星への祈りが込められてるの
us: All of our fabulous designs have been infused with prayers to the planet!

jp: 羽根かざりに　毛皮に天然石
us: We've got plumes, furs, and stones!

jp:
谷の娘たちが願いを込めて
丁寧に細工をほどこしているのよ
us: All of the items we offer are handcrafted by the vale's most skilled artisans!

jp:
コスモキャンドルでご祈祷済み
星の恵みを　どうかあなたに
us: Don't miss out on this chance to carry a blessing of the planet with you wherever you go!

jp:
ああ　星よ
あなたの元に帰る日は近い
us: O great mother... Soon I will return to your bosom.

jp:
コスモキャンディにコスモ焼き
空のお星様が落っこちるほど美味しいよ
us: Come try our signature canyon candies and snacks! They're so good, they'll send your taste buds straight to the cosmos!

jp:
素朴で優しい味だよ
観光のおともにもオススメさ
us: Hankering to add some flavor to your visit? Take our snacks with you as you see the sights!

jp:
星を巡るエネルギーはすべて
我々の祖先であり子孫なのです
us: The energy coursing through the planet includes those who came before, and those who will come after.

jp:
星に祈ることは
魂が星と結びつくこと
us: Know this: to offer a prayer unto the planet is to join one's soul with it.

jp:
星は　いつでも私たちの心に
語りかけているわ
us: The planet─she speaks to us, each and every moment of our lives.

jp:
すべては星の恵み
無駄なものなど　ひとつもないのですよ
us: Even though we may struggle to see it, everything with which the planet has blessed us has a purpose.

jp: どんなときも　星に感謝を捧げねば
us: We must live our lives with gratitude in our hearts for the planet.

jp:
星の恵み　そのすべてに
敬意を払うのです
us: The planet's blessings are many, and we must take none for granted.

jp:
今日は年にいちどの
特別な日なのです
us: Today is a special day─one that only comes once a year.

jp:
この日に谷を訪れたのも
星のお導きでしょう
us: It must've been the planet's will that you made it to the canyon just in time.

jp:
今宵の星送りも
すばらしいものになりますよ
us: I believe you'll find the ceremony this evening to be quite engaging.

jp: 今日は夜に　お祭りがあるんです
us: The festival this evening may be of interest to you.

jp: ぜひ　星送りの儀も見ていってください
us: You're more than welcome to come watch the River of Lights.

jp: 星送りは　谷の大切な儀式なのです
us: The River of Lights is an important festival here in the vale.

jp:
今宵の儀も
無事に執り行われますように
us: By the light of the festival, may the lost return home.

jp:
私たちも
星送りを心待ちにしているのよ
us: We're really looking forward to experiencing the River of Lights tonight.

jp: 日が落ちたら　星送りが始まるわ
us: The ceremony will begin after sundown.

jp:
星よ　今宵も正しき道を
お示しください

us: And those lines... They were caused by ancient lifestream currents?

jp:
そうだ　地層はいわば
この星の年表
us: Indeed. Strata like these are a window into history.

jp:
はるか昔から幾重にも積み重なり
時に隆起し　削られ　風化し
us: Layers upon layers of rock and sediment, built up and worn down over countless millennia.

jp:
我々は　その歴史の
ほんの一瞬の上に立っているに過ぎん
us: An eternity compared to the brief moment that is a human life.

jp:
ようこそ
バー『スターレット』へ
us: Welcome, friend, to the Starlet pub.

jp:
オリジナルカクテルの
『コスモキャンドル』が人気ですよ
us: If you're lookin' for a drink, the Torch is our biggest hit.

jp:
新作カクテルの『ライフストリーム』は
もうお試しになりましたか？
us: I also recently came up with a new cocktail─"the Lifestream." Care to try it?

jp:
この酒場では
いにしえより星命学について
様々な議論が交わされてきました
us: For generations, this tavern has served as a place for us to debate planetological theories.

jp:
我々はこの星と
魂の奥底で深く繋がっているのです
us: At our very core, we are connected to the planet in ways that defy description.

jp:
谷の酒造の歴史は古く　かつては
星の声を聞く儀式に用いられていたんだ
us: The vale has a history of brewing its own spirits. Some were even used in ceremonies at one point.

jp: ここは　星命学者の憩いの場なのです
us: For many of us, the tavern is a home away from home.

jp:
酒もまた　星の恵みですよ
飲み過ぎは……いけませんよ……
us: We have the planet to thank for these spirits too. Gotta consume 'em with the proper─hrk─reverence.

jp: ここには星命学の徒が集うの
us: This is where all the students come to take a load off.

jp:
次の星命学会での発表
どうしようかしら
us: I still need to decide on a subject for my next seminar.

jp:
次のセミナーまで休憩のつもりが
うう……飲み過ぎてしまった
us: I was just gonna take a little break until the next seminar, but... Hrk! Drank too much.

jp: お酒は議論の潤滑油としても優秀よ
us: Nothing like a stiff drink to get the creative juices flowing.

jp:
『賢者よ　酒場へ集い語らえ』
古くからの習わしです
us: "O wise ones! Gather at the bar and let your knowledge be shared!" And so we have, for generations untold.

jp:
最近の若者は
議論もまともにできんらしい
us: It's difficult to have a proper discussion with young people these days.

jp:
星について
おおいに語りあおうじゃないか！
us: Why don't we discuss our incredible planet over drinks?

jp:
星はすべての者たちに
等しく語りかけています
us: The planet speaks to all of her children. No one is greater or lesser in her eyes.

jp:
ここで交わされる議論が
星命学の小さな希望の星とならんことを
us: May the conversations held here become the spark that rekindles hope for planetology and mankind.

jp:
私も昔は『コスモキャンドル』を片手に
熱い議論を交わしたものです
us: I spent many an evening here engaged in vigorous debate─always with a Torch in hand!

jp:
お酒こそ
この星最大の恵みかもしれないわね
us: Sometimes I think alcohol just might be the planet's greatest blessing of all!

jp:
このリキュール
独特のかおりだな
us: This liquor has an unmistakable aroma.

jp:
ふはははは！
『集え　星命学の同士よ』ってか～
us: Love how they talk around here! "Gather round, fellow planetologists!"

jp: う～ん　目のまえに星が見える～
us: Whoa... It's like the planet's floatin' right in front of me.

jp: 星の恵みにカンパーイ！
us: To the blessings of the planet! Cheers!

jp:
星に思いをはせながらの酒も
悪くない
us: Maybe I've had one too many, but I get the planet now.

jp:
うう……
次のセミナーは……なんだっけ？
us: Urgh... Ummm, what was the next seminar about again?

jp: ふふ　いまなら星に帰ってもいいわ～私
us: Heh! You know, I could return to the planet right now and be completely satisfied.

jp:
星命学は不思議な学問よ
何年学んでも知りたいことが尽きないの
us: I've been studying planetology for years now, but there's always more for me to learn. Its depths are immeasurable.

jp: 香草の複雑な風味がなんとも言えないわ
us: This liquor has an herbal bouquet that's indescribable.

jp:
アルコールエネルギーが
私の中を駆け巡る～
us: If mako is the planet's lifeblood, then alcohol is my lifeblood!

jp:
ガスト博士……
あなたから学んだことは
いまも我々の中に息づいていますよ
us: Oh, Professor Gast. I hope you know that your legacy lives on─that your discoveries paved the way for our successes.

jp:
あなたほど真面目で
すばらしい学者はほかにいなかった
us: What other scholar could ever hope to match your passion and excellence?

jp: それなのに　どうして……
us: Why did you have to leave us?

jp:
気づけば日々　星の中に
あなたの声を探しているようです
us: Every day I strain to listen and pluck out your voice from the planet's chorus...

jp:
コスモキャニオンの酒はもともと
祭事に用いる目的で作られた
神聖なものなんだ
us: This variety of spirits is sacred, actually. In fact, it was originally brewed for ceremonial use!

jp:
周辺でとれる植物が主な原料なんだが
その醸造方法は門外不出と言われている
us: Local flora make up the bulk of what's used to brew it─though the exact method for doing so is a closely guarded secret!

jp:
あら　じゃあ
コスモソルトについては知ってる？
谷の周辺でしかとれない貴重な塩
us: My, aren't you well informed. Then you know about Cosmo salt? It's a special kind only found around here.

jp:
悲しみもまた　星からの授かりもの
嘆くことはありません
us: Sorrow is not a burden─far from it. It is yet another of the planet's gifts.

jp:
この土地特有のミネラルの影響で
精製すると
まるで星のような結晶構造になるのよ
us: A unique property of the local minerals causes it to take on a star-like shape when processed. It's really quite something.

jp:
魔晄エネルギーなんてもう古い！
これからは星命学の時代
us: If you ask me, planetology's the future! Mako's old news.

jp: 星に優しい風力発電で生活すべきだ
us: I say we replace the stuff with wind power!

jp:
そうだそうだ
神羅カンパニーなんて潰れちゃえ～！
us: Yeah, down with Shinra! We'd be so much better off without them!

jp:
ちょっと　そんな大声で……
アバランチだと思われたらどうすんのよ
us: You can't talk like that, at least not in public. What if people start thinking you're with Avalanche?

jp:
セミナーが行われています
どうぞ　お静かに
us: A seminar is in progress. Please be respectful.

jp: ただいま　セミナーは休講中です
us: There is no seminar being held here at the moment.

jp: なにか　ご用ですか？
us: Can I help you?

jp:
さあ　お次の方
どうぞお話しください
us: Very well. Let us have our next speaker share their words with us.

jp:
星命学とは星について　ひいては
己についてを知る学問なのです
us: To study planetology is to seek to know our planet─and by extension, to know ourselves.

jp:
私は　数年前まで
神羅に勤めていました
us: I used to work for Shinra. Up until a few years ago.

jp:
魔晄炉の点検を担当していたのですが
体を壊す同僚も多い職場で……
us: Was a maintenance guy in a reactor. It's a dangerous job─costs a lotta people their health.

jp:
かくいう私も　遂に魔晄中毒で倒れ
意識を失っている間に夢を見たんです
us: Cost me mine... I passed out on the job─mako poisoning. But while I was unconscious, I...had this dream.

jp:
夢の中では死んだ母や同僚たちが
嘆き　悲しんでいました
us: Saw friends I'd lost. My mom too. They were crying. In pain.

jp:
目が覚めた私は　神羅を辞め
星命学を学びはじめました
us: When I woke up, I quit the company. Started studying planetology.

jp:
星はいまも神羅によって汚され
傷ついている
us: That dream opened my eyes to what Shinra was doing.

jp:
母のため　同僚のため
正しい判断をしたと　そう思います
us: Quitting was the best thing I ever did. It was the right thing to do─for the people I loved.

jp: 星とともにあらんことを
us: Blessings of the planet upon you.

jp: すばらしい！
us: Amazing!

jp:
星命学を学びはじめて７０年
まだまだ　ヒヨッコです
us: It has been seventy years since I embarked upon my journey, yet I still have so much to learn.

jp:
僕たちは……その
長いあいだ子供に恵まれなくて
us: We'd been trying for so long to have a child, but...nothing seemed to be working.

jp:
いままでいろんな治療を試して
たくさん　たくさん悩んできました
us: We'd gone through every treatment under the sun. It was...it was tough.

jp:
命を生み出すことができない私たちは
精神エネルギーの循環から
はずれてしまっているのではないかと
us: After years, we started to wonder if something else was going on. Like maybe we'd been cut off from the planet─from its energy.

jp:
でも　子供をもうける以外にも
命をはぐくむことはできますよね？
us: But then we realized that there were other ways to nurture life, besides raising a family.

jp:
木を植えたり　畑を耕したり
親を失った子供たちと支えあったり
us: We could plant trees, grow crops, or even help children who had lost their parents.

jp:
すべての命が星に帰るのならば
私たちも　そういう形で
星に貢献することができるんじゃないか
us: All life returns to the planet and is reborn eventually. We could still contribute to the cycle─just not in the way we'd planned.

jp:
そう考えて　私たちは
この地への移住を決意しました
us: That's why we decided to move here and start fresh. To have an impact.

jp:
我らはみな　生まれる前から
この星を巡る旅人なのです
us: Before we are even born, we are travelers. Souls adrift in her currents.

jp:
私　小さい頃からずっと
早く星に帰りたい　早く早く……と
そればかり考えていました
us: For as long as I can remember, I wanted to return to the planet. In my waking moments and in my dreams, these thoughts were always with me.

jp:
この世に私を愛してくれる人はいない
私が居るべき場所は　星の中なんだって
us: I felt as though no one truly loved me─and never would. That there was no place for me with others─only with her.

jp:
そんな私を持てあました両親は
私を　コスモキャニオンへと
連れてきました
us: My parents tried to understand, but they couldn't. That's why they brought me to Cosmo Canyon.

jp:
星命学の教えに触れるうち
すこしずつ私の考えは変わりました
us: But as I lived here and learned more about planetology...my view on things started to change.

jp:
星に帰ったとき持っていけるのは
この世界で生きた記憶だけなんです
us: I realized that, when I do return, the only thing I can take with me are my memories.

jp:
星は我々を育み　我々もまた
星を育んでいるのです
us: As the planet nurtures us, we in turn are to nurture the planet. This is our duty.

jp:
星に帰った私が
幸せに過ごすためには
us: And if I want to be happy and at peace when I'm one with her...

jp:
この世界で　より多くのものを
得なければダメなんだって
us: I need to live a full life─experience as much as I can.

jp:
いま私は　もっと知りたい
もっと生きたいと　そう思っています
us: I want to learn, see, and do more─enjoy everything the world has to offer!

jp: すべては　ここでの学びのおかげです
us: And I owe this new perspective to everyone here.

jp: 夫はウータイ戦争で命を落としました
us: I lost my husband. Back in the war with Wutai.

jp:
誰もがつらい思いをしたはずなのに
世界はまた戦争を始めようとしている
us: In spite of all that pain and suffering, the world looks like it's on the brink of violence again.

jp:
どうして人は
あやまちばかり繰り返すのでしょう
us: Why do people always have to repeat the mistakes of the past?

jp:
長い歴史の中で　人々は何度も
争うことの虚しさを学んだはずなのに
us: Humanity has had such a long history and so many chances to learn how futile war and conflict are.

jp:
星に帰っていった多くの魂たちも
そのことをよく知っているはずなのに
us: Nobody knows that better than those we've lost─those who have returned to the planet and rejoined the lifestream.

jp:
星はすべてを与えてくださる
我々はただ信じ　求めればよいのです
us: The planet beneath our feet grants unto us her blessings. We have but to place our faith in her─and ask.

jp:
星の声に耳を傾けさえすれば
誰しも　争いが無意味だということを
思い出すはずなのです
us: If only we would stop and listen to what they have to say, everyone still fighting would realize what war really is: empty and meaningless.

jp:
戦争というものはきっと　人の心から
星の声を聞き入れる余裕が失われた時に
起きるのでしょう
us: When we close our hearts to the voice of the planet, when we refuse to let its words fill our souls with love─that's when we become our own worst enemy.

jp: あなたの発表　すごく良かった
us: That was a really moving speech. You did great.

jp:
私たちが出会ったのも
あなたが苦しんでいた頃だったわよね
us: Come to think of it...you were going through quite the rough patch the first time we met too.

jp:
ああ　俺がいまこうしていられるのも
君のおかげだ
us: Yeah. I'd have said the hell with it and given up if it weren't for you.

jp:
思えばぜんぶ
星の導きだったのかもな
us: Almost feels like the planet wanted us to find each other.

jp:
ええ　私たち
ライフストリームだった頃から
こうしていっしょに旅をしていたのかも
us: Doesn't it? We must have been inseparable even in the lifestream─coursing around the world and mingling together as one.

jp:
セミナーでいろんな話を聞いてるうちに
俺もわかったんだ
俺のなすべきことが！
us: All the time I've spent here, listening and learning, has helped me realize what I'm meant to do in this world!

jp:
我々が星に耳を傾けるとき
星も我々の声に耳を傾けているのです
us: We must strive to heed the planet's call, lending her our ears, but remember: she too is always listening.

jp:
俺の使命は　徳を積んで魂の質を高め
みんなの役に立って　この星を守ること
us: I should be a force for good. Help folks out, spread positive vibes─that's how I'll protect the planet.

jp:
昨日は困ってた婆ちゃんを背負って
買い物につきあったし
今日はバーのゴミ出しを手伝ったし
us: Like yesterday, I helped this poor old woman carry her groceries! And today, I took out the trash at the bar.

jp:
いままでずっとモヤモヤしてたけど
ようやく腑に落ちたよ
us: I've been floating through my life without any purpose, but I've finally found it!

jp: 星命学ってすげえな　ホント！
us: Planetology has made me a better me!

jp:
さあ　目を閉じて……
己の中に響く星の声に耳を傾けるのです
us: Relax, close your eyes, and listen... Listen to the voice of the planet resounding within your very soul.

jp:
ただ　心の奥底に響く声を
あるがまま受け入れればいいのです
us: Let the voice rise up and wash over you, that it may guide your steps on the path to enlightenment.

jp: 恐れず　ゆっくりと身を委ねて……
us: Don't be afraid. Relax and give yourself over to the planet.

jp: はい　ゆっくりと目を開けて……
us: Now, slowly open your eyes...

jp:
セトラ研究の権威であるガスト博士も
以前はよく　この谷においででした
us: Professor Gast often visited the vale. I must say, it was always an honor to receive such an eminent scholar of the Cetra.

jp:
いかがでしたか？
星は　常に我々に語りかけています
us: Did you hear it? Remember: the planet is always speaking, and we need but listen.

jp:
心穏やかにその声に耳を澄ませば
誰でも星に寄り添うことができるのです
us: If we still our hearts and open our ears, all of us can attune ourselves to the planet─and to the wisdom of her words.

jp: では　もういちど
us: Let us focus once more...

jp:
瞑想を繰り返しているうちに
星がなんて言っているのか
私にもわかるようになってきた気がする
us: I think meditation has really helped me attune to the voice of the planet. Everything she says seems so much clearer to me now.

jp:
俺も……なんか
動物の言葉がわかるようになったかも
us: Yeah, I know what you mean. Lately I've felt like I can make out what animals are saying.

jp: ええっ　どういうこと？
us: Uh... What?

jp:
聞こえたんだ　大きな犬が
『じっちゃん　ただいま～！』ってさ
us: No, seriously! I heard it clear as day, some kinda dog yelling "I'm back!"

jp:
さあ　では呼吸を通じて
この星を巡る精神エネルギーを
体内に取り込んでみましょう
us: Through the practice of mindful breathing, we can tap into the flow of the planet's spiritual energy and bring it into ourselves.

jp:
星命学についての質問なら
いつでも　歓迎しますよ
us: I would be more than happy to answer any questions you might have regarding planetology.

jp: まずは　鼻からゆっくり息を吸って……
us: First, a deep, calming breath through the nose.

jp:
肺や腹に取り込まれた精神エネルギーが
血液によって全身に運ばれていく様子を
イメージしましょう
us: Visualize the energy entering into your lungs. Feel it work its way through you─to your fingertips and toes.

jp:
全身を巡ったエネルギーは
あなたの口から星へと帰っていきます
us: Let it fill your body, then breathe out...that the energy may return to the planet.

jp: すぅ～　はぁ～……
us: Hihhh... Hahhh...

jp:
酸素が血液とともに体を巡るのと同様
精神エネルギーもこの星を循環し
星の営みに必要な栄養を届けています
us: In the same way oxygen circulates through our bodies in the blood, spiritual energy courses through the planet. It is what allows the world to sustain our many diverse forms of life.

jp:
呼吸を感じることは　すなわち
精神エネルギーの流れを感じること
us: Through mindful breathing, we are in effect attuning to the natural flow of spiritual energy.

jp:
繰り返していくことで
星との一体感を感じられるはずです
us: And through regular practice, we can experience a union with the planet.

jp:
星とひとつになる己をイメージして
もういちど繰り返してみましょう
us: Focus now on that sense of oneness with our world, and then we will begin again.

jp:
欲張ってはならぬのは学問も同じ
必要な知識はおのずと与えられるのです
us: One must exercise patience in the pursuit of knowledge. For that which we truly need to know, we shall learn in time.

jp:
それではこれより　私と谷を巡り
精神エネルギーの循環を
体感していただきます
us: We will now embark on our tour of the vale, whereby you may all experience the flow of spiritual energy.

jp:
いまここにいる我々は　黎明の時代
星に生まれ落ちたばかりの魂なのです
us: Our journey begins here, at the dawn of life─as newborn souls, freshly birthed by the planet.

jp:
なにも恐れることはありません
星とともに歩み始めましょう
us: Though the road ahead is unknown, we are not afraid, for we walk with the great mother at our side.

jp:
この星に生まれ落ちた我々は
数多の幸せと悲しみをくぐり抜け
ここまでやって参りました
us: After receiving the gift of life, we must endure countless sorrows─yet beyond the hardships, happiness awaits.

jp: これこそが　黄金の時代
us: This is our golden age.

jp:
谷を巡る中で　みなさんの心の中にも
これまでの人生で経験してきた
様々な出来事が蘇ったことでしょう
us: Our tour of the vale thus far has no doubt called to mind many emotions and experiences. Let us take a moment to reflect on them now.

jp:
我々はこうして日々　精神エネルギーを
高めながら生きているのです
us: Through regular spiritual communion, we may all come to live more fulfilling lives.

jp: さあ　いよいよ夕暮れの時代
us: And now, we reach the age of twilight.

jp:
あなたが培ってきた経験や知識は
まさに夕日が沈むかの如く
すこしずつ星へと帰ってゆくのです
us: As the sun sinks below the horizon, so too does our knowledge and experience─our very essence─rejoin with the planet.

jp:
ここで人生のすべてを
星命学に捧げるつもりよ
us: I plan to devote the rest of my life to studying planetology. There's no worthier cause.

jp: 忘却を恐れることはありません
us: Yet we need not fear this return.

jp:
肉体から離れゆく記憶こそ
次の命へと受け継がれる
エネルギーのバトンに他ならないのです
us: The memories that survive our flesh are a gift─a legacy to be inherited by future generations of life.

jp: さあ　コスモキャンドルをご覧なさい
us: Finally, let us gaze upon the bonfire.

jp:
星に帰った魂たちが混ざりあい
ひとつの大きなエネルギーとなって
星の中で燃えさかっている
us: The souls that have returned whence they came merge with the glorious star that burns bright within the heart of our planet.

jp: あの輝きこそ　夜明けの時代の始まり
us: And from this blinding brilliance arises a new dawn.

jp:
ひとつの生を終えた魂は
星の祝福を得て
再びこの星に生まれ直すのです
us: For the souls that have finished one life receive the blessings of the planet, and in time shall be born again.

jp:
我々はこうして
永遠に旅を繰り返していくのです
us: This concludes our tour─though our spiritual journey is without end.

jp:
ああ　ナナキのご友人がた
ナナキなら天文台へ行きましたよ
us: Hm, you must be Nanaki's friends. He's gone up to the observatory, if you're wondering.

jp:
星のことわりに従えば
おのずと　答えは出ます
us: If you attune yourself with the natural flow of the planet, the answers will come.

jp:
ブーゲンハーゲン様から話は聞いております
ぜひとも　セミナーにご参加ください
us: I heard from Fellow Bugenhagen. By all means, please come and join the seminar.

jp: 会場まで　ご案内いたします
us: Follow me if you would.

jp: どうぞ　セミナー会場にお進みください
us: Please continue on into the assembly.

jp:
申し訳ありません
このエレベーターはメンテナンス中です
us: I'm sorry, but the elevator is currently undergoing maintenance.

jp:
始まりは星であり
終わりもまた星なのです
us: Just as all things begin with the planet, so too do they end.

jp:
すべての命は星のもの
粗末に扱ってはなりません
us: Every life is born of the planet, and must be afforded love and affection.

jp:
今宵は星の魂が谷に満ちる日
星の力をより身近に感じられるでしょう
us: Already I feel the planet's essence more keenly. Tonight, we shall all be as one with the lifestream.

jp:
星送りとは魂を星に返す儀式
終わりであり　始まりでもあるのです
us: Souls in waiting are returned to the planet through the River of Lights. It serves as both an ending and a new beginning.

jp:
コスモキャンドルは星の命の象徴
星送りも　あの場所で行われます
us: The bonfire symbolizes the life of the planet, so it's fitting that it should serve as the site for the River of Lights.

jp:
星送りの夜は　星と我々が
より深く結ばれるのです
us: The bond between us and the planet deepens on the night of the River of Lights.

jp:
星の恵みを星へと返す
星送りは星へ感謝を捧げる祭なのです
us: The River of Lights is one way we show our gratitude to the planet. Through it, we return her blessing of life.

jp:
谷には星送りのほかに
星鎮めと呼ばれる儀式もあるのですよ
us: There's also a sister ceremony to the River of Lights, in which the bonfire is extinguished.

jp:
星送りの歴史は古く　その起源は
セトラの時代に遡るとも言われます
us: The River of Lights has a long and storied history, which can be traced back as far as the time of the Cetra themselves.

jp:
星送りとは　この星の
魂の循環を模した儀式なのです
us: The River of Lights ceremony evokes the cyclical flow of life on the planet.

jp:
最近は　観光のついでのように
星送りに参加するお客人も増えましたな
us: Many travelers have joined in the River of Lights as of late, but their interest in our vale ends there.

jp:
星について　より深く知りたければ
星送りの儀に参加なさい
us: If you wish to deepen your understanding of the planet, you should participate in the River of Lights.

jp:
星送りは神聖な儀式
軽んじてはなりませんよ
us: The River of Lights is a sacred ritual, not some tourist attraction.

jp:
わたくしも若い頃には
星送りの巫女に憧れたものです
us: When I was a young girl, I dreamed of one day leading the River of Lights ceremony.

jp:
もう夜も遅い
また明日の朝おいでください
us: The hour is late, my friends. Please come again tomorrow morning.

jp:
星送りの夜の空は
いつにも増して美しい……
us: The beauty of the stars grows tenfold on the night we hold the River of Lights.

jp: 明日の朝には勉強会も再開されます
us: There will be a seminar held tomorrow morning, as well.

jp:
あなたにも
星の導きがありますように
us: I pray that the planet will see fit to guide you true.

jp: あまり夜中に出歩かれませんよう
us: Take care not to leave the town after dark.

jp: あら　寝付けないのですか？
us: Oh, are you having trouble sleeping?

jp:
今宵　なにかを感じたのであれば
星命学を学ばれるとよいでしょう
us: If you were moved by what you witnessed tonight, then you should begin your personal study of planetology.

jp: あなたも　星の祝福を感じますかな？
us: The planet's grace is all around us. Can you feel it?

jp:
星とともに生きる喜び
おわかりになりましたか
us: In time, all will come to know the joy of living in harmony with the planet.

jp:
星送りの儀にも
星命学の教えが息づいているのです
us: I hope the River of Lights has given you insight into the tenets of planetology.

jp:
今宵　胸の内に芽生えた感謝の気持ちを
大切になさい
us: May the seeds of gratitude sown in your heart bloom into true appreciation for our planet.

jp: 星の祝福があらんことを
us: May the planet watch over and keep you safe.

jp:
戦争など……
星命学を知らぬ愚か者のやることです
us: War is the purview of fools ignorant of planetology and its higher truths.

jp:
なにがあろうとも
星が我々を守ってくれるでしょう
us: Come what may, the planet will always watch over and protect its children.

jp:
星がすべてを決める
我々はそれに従うのみです
us: The planet is the arbiter of all things. We have but to heed its will.

jp: 星は　必ず我らを救ってくださいます
us: Trust in our mother, from whom all blessings flow.

jp:
争いなど……
星がどれほど嘆いていることか
us: I can only imagine how it must pain the planet to watch us wage these wars.

jp:
時に道を踏みはずそうとも
我々は常に　星とともにあるのです
us: Even when we go astray, the planet guides our every step until we return to the path.

jp:
争う者たちに
星の声は聞こえないのでしょう
us: Why would they choose war? Can't they hear the planet's cries?

jp:
いまこそ　星命学が
必要とされているのです
us: The world needs planetology now more than ever before.

jp:
我々と星は一心同体
我々が穏やかであれば
星もまた　穏やかとなるのです
us: Our hearts and minds are bound to the planet. When at last we attain inner peace, so too shall our world.

jp:
星の声から遠ざかれば道を見失う
当然のことです
us: The further we stray from the light of our great mother, the more lost we become.

jp:
星命学者である我々にできることは
星のことわりを教え　説くことのみです
us: We humble students of planetology can do little but endeavor to share the wisdom of our mother with any who will listen.

jp:
人は間違いを犯す
そのたびに星は傷つけられてきたのです
us: Humans are destined to err. And each time we do, we bring harm upon our great mother.

jp:
近頃は　星の声を聞かぬ者が
増えすぎました
us: More and more people are growing deaf to the cries of the planet. I worry for our future.

jp:
憎しみとはすなわち感情の淀み
循環が滞れば　星はいずれ病んでしまう
us: Hatred is but the stagnation of emotion. If the flow is disrupted, the corruption that arises will spread throughout the planet. Like a disease.

jp:
戦争もまた　愚かな人間を滅ぼすための
星の意思なのかもしれません
us: Some have theorized that war is an instrument of the planet's will─a means to cull the ignorant and malicious.

jp:
星命学を学びなさい
その先に　必ず救いは見つかります
us: Learn all that planetology has to teach us. Do this, and rest assured that you will find salvation.

jp: 空を見あげてご覧なさい
us: Lift your gaze to the heavens.

jp:
流れゆく雲はただ
風の吹くままに身をまかせている
us: Watch as the clouds drift through the sky, going whichever way the wind takes them.

jp:
我々も同じ……
この星の導きに従えば良いのですね
us: We humans are the same. The planet charts a course for us, and we need only walk it.

jp:
左様　導きの先にこそ
我々が求めし安寧の地があるのです
us: Quite right. All we need to do is follow its guidance, for one day it will surely lead us to the tranquility we seek.

jp: 谷の奥底に淀みし者たち……
us: Beneath our vale, bound and stagnant...

jp:
星はなぜ　このような試練を
我らにお与えになったと考える？
us: Do you have any notion as to why the planet would choose to set such a trial before us?

jp:
我らに乗り越える力があることを
星はご存知だからです
us: I believe it is because she is confident that we have the strength to overcome it.

jp:
我々が困難を克服し
今日を無事に過ごしていることこそ
なによりの証拠です
us: The fact that we stand here today, alive and well─having overcome our challenges─is proof of this.

jp:
うむ　何事にも
星が定めし理由がある
us: Indeed. As the planet ordains, so it shall be.

jp: そのことを　ゆめゆめ忘れてはならぬぞ
us: This truth is absolute and must never be forgotten.

jp:
すべての命は星を巡る
歩みを　旅を止めてはなりません
us: We yearn to chase the horizon. Embrace exploration, wheresoever it takes you.

jp:
流れ漂うこと　それこそが
星の命の本質なのです
us: To drift about─to wander from place to place─that is the essence of life.

jp: 師よ　あなたも旅に出られるのですか？
us: Then, sir... Will you be embarking on a journey?

jp: そのときは近い
us: Quite soon, yes.

jp:
星命学の教えを世に広める使命が
我らにはあるのですから
us: For our mission is to spread the teachings of planetology to one and all.

jp:
星命学を多くの人々へ広めることと
己の星命学への理解を深めること
us: Tell me: is it better to spread the teachings of planetology to others, or to focus on deepening our own understanding?

jp: 我々はどちらを目指すべきなのでしょう
us: Which, would you say, is a more worthy pursuit?

jp:
どちらも同じこと
星は我らであり　我らもまた星
us: They are both one and the same, wouldn't you agree? We are as much a part of the planet as it is a part of us.

jp:
他者と己の区別など
本来　ありはしないのです
us: At one time, there was no distinction...no lines to separate us.

jp:
星への道を見誤りさえしなければ
やがては同じ場所へと帰りつくでしょう
us: And so long as we do not stray from our path, one day we shall all return to and rejoin the greater whole.

jp: どのセミナーも気になるなあ
us: The seminars all look so interesting!

jp:
瞑想会　参加したけど
すごくよかったよ
us: I went to a meditation session─cleared my mind right up!

jp:
勉強会で呼吸法を学んだばかりなんだ
すぅ～はぁ～……
us: I just learned about mindful breathing at one of the workshops! Hah...fwoo...

jp: 次のセッションって何時からだっけ？
us: Hey, what time's the next session at again?

jp:
う～ん……
スターレットでひと息いれるか
us: Hnng... Maybe I'll chill at the Starlet.

jp: みんな　星命学を学ぶ仲間なんだ！
us: It's so great learning about planetology with everyone!

jp:
こうしている間にも
星は俺たちに語りかけてるんだな
us: I bet the planet's speaking to us right now. All we have to do is listen!

jp:
さっきの勉強会の担当メンター
ちょっと　かっこよかったかも
us: I joined a seminar earlier, but the mentor running it was so hot, I couldn't focus.

jp:
次の勉強会まで
いちど　ホテルに戻ろうかな
us: I need to rest my brain at the hotel before the next seminar.

jp:
初心者には
呼吸法のセミナーがオススメよ
us: Try the inhalation seminar. It's breathtaking!

jp: はあ～　邪念がデトックスされてく～
us: Wicked thoughts begone! Good vibes only!

jp: 誰かセミナーに推薦してくれないかな～
us: So many seminars... Where do I even start?

jp: ようこそ　ナナキのご友人がた
us: A warm welcome to you, friends of Nanaki.

jp: ここは星の知識が集まる天文台です
us: Here we seek to gather the wisdom of the planet.

jp:
ここで働けることは
我々の誇りです
us: Working here is an incredible honor.

jp:
宇宙ほど
緻密で美しいものはありません
us: Nothing is as beautifully complex as the cosmos.

jp: 宇宙は常に発見に満ちていますよ
us: There is so much we have yet to learn about the universe.

jp:
ここにある資料の半分は
ガスト博士からの寄贈なんですよ
us: We have Professor Gast to thank for a full half of the research materials archived here.

jp:
人は星々から
多くのことを学んできました
us: The stars have taught us countless lessons over the years.

jp:
ブーゲンハーゲン様も我々も
ナナキのことを心配しておりました
us: We've all been worried sick about Nanaki, Fellow Bugenhagen chiefly among us.

jp: ブーゲンハーゲン様に失礼のないように
us: Mind your manners in front of Fellow Bugenhagen.

jp:
すべての物事は
星の営みと連動しているのです
us: The planet connects us, one and all. For everything exists through her.

jp:
神羅はまた　あやまちを
繰り返そうとしているのですね
us: Shinra's about to commit some more grave mistakes.

jp:
戦争になるまえに
資料を移動させなければなりません
us: We need to move our records to a safe location before war breaks out.

jp:
争うこともまた
人のさだめなのでしょうか
us: I wonder if it's just our nature to wage war with one another.

jp:
星の意思と戦争は
私の研究テーマでもあります
us: War─and the planet's will regarding it─is the subject of my research.

jp:
戦争なんて
まさに精神エネルギーの浪費
us: Nothing is a greater waste of spiritual energy than war.

jp:
反神羅連絡会……
類似の組織の記録なら
いくつか残っているはずだけど
us: While they aren't an exact match, we have records of several organizations resembling the SRC.

jp:
ああ　ダメダメ
見学者の方の出入りはお断りです
us: Not so fast. Sorry, but visitors aren't allowed in here.

jp: ここは　貴重品を保管してる倉庫なんですよ
us: You see, this is where we keep all our valuables.

jp:
ブーゲン様の許可がおりて
鍵を受け取った人だけが入ることができます
us: Only those who have the key─as well as Fellow Bugenhagen's permission─are allowed inside.

jp:
ナナキがお世話になったそうですね
ありがとうございます
us: Thanks so much for taking such great care of Nanaki for us.

jp:
ブーゲン様から　倉庫にある旅に役立つ物品を
ご自由にお持ちいただくように言われてます
us: Fellow Bugenhagen instructed me to let you take anything you think might prove useful on your journey.

jp: ぜひ　倉庫にお立ち寄りください
us: Check out the storeroom when you have a chance.

jp: どうぞ　どうぞ
us: Come on in!

jp:
我々がここで観測しているものは
はるか彼方から届く太古の光
us: The lights we observe here have traveled to us from the far reaches of time and space.

jp:
星を見つめるということは　すなわち
星の過去と語りあうことなのです
us: To gaze at the stars is to gaze into their past─what they once were, eons ago.

jp: 星の行く末になど　興味はありません
us: Can't say I'm all that interested in the future.

jp:
我々の目はいつだって
過ぎ去った過去の姿しか
とらえることができないのですから
us: But that's just how we're wired. Humans can't help but fixate on the past─on what used to be.

jp:
ああ　今日はまた一段と美しい
星の知識が歌うように語りかけてくる
us: I never thought you could become even more enchanting, and yet... It's like you're singing to me of the planet's wisdom.

jp:
うん　僕にまかせておけば大丈夫
君の魅力のすべてを引き出してあげるよ
us: Don't you worry, my dear. I'll find a way to bring out the full depths of your beauty. Cross my heart.

jp:
ここは聖なる場所
むやみに近づかれませんよう
us: Sacred though it is, be sure not to wander too close to the bonfire.

jp: 今日もどうか　谷をお守りください
us: Please continue to watch over and protect the canyon.

jp: コスモキャンドルは　谷の宝だよ
us: The bonfire is the heart of Cosmo Canyon.

jp:
あの炎は　私が生まれるずっとまえから
燃え続けているのよ
us: That flame has been burning since long before I was born. Kind of crazy to think about...

jp:
あれほど美しい炎を
ほかに知りません
us: There's something strangely enchanting about this fire.

jp: ここでは騒がしくしないでね
us: Please keep your voice down here.

jp: 星の導きのあらんことを
us: May the planet guide you home.

jp: 帰りゆく魂に　どうか祝福を
us: May these souls find peace within her embrace.

jp: 無事　星に帰れますように
us: May your journey home be straight and swift.

jp: どうか　魂が迷うことのないよう
us: I pray these souls do not lose their way.

jp: 炎よ　星に帰る魂をお守りください
us: O sacred Flame... Protect these souls as they travel home.

jp: どうか　星のもとへ……
us: May the planet embrace you...

jp:
コスモキャンドルは
谷が生まれた遠い遠い昔から
us: The Torch of Cosmo Canyon was first lit long ago, when the vale itself was born.

jp:
雨の降りしきる日も
風の吹きすさぶ日も
この場所で燃え続けておる
us: Its flames ever burn─they do not falter on the rainiest of days, nor when the wind blows fierce and relentless.

jp:
コスモキャンドルは
星の命そのもの
us: This balefire is the very life of the planet itself.

jp:
こうしてお守りできることは
谷の誇りなのじゃ
us: To stand vigil as one of its guardians is a sacred duty that I embrace.

jp:
５０年にいちど
星鎮めの日だけは　あの炎が消える
us: It is but once every fifty years, on a day when all grows still, that the fires fade.

jp:
星も　我々と同じように
幾度となく生まれ直しておるのじゃよ
us: Just as we who live upon it, the planet has been reborn countless times─as ever it will be.

jp:
燃えさかる炎をながめておると
かつてこの谷を去っていった
アバランチの若者たちを思い出す
us: Some carry a fire that rivals even this. Like the youths who left the vale years ago. Avalanche, they called themselves.

jp:
彼らの胸には
星を守りたいという強い想いがあった
us: They were young, but the desire to protect the planet burned bright within their hearts.

jp: 私に彼らを止めることはできんかったよ
us: And who were we to quench such noble passions?

jp:
彼らが再び谷に戻ってくることがあれば
そのときは　どのような状況であろうと
受け入れてやりたいと思っておる
us: Though their path led them elsewhere, if they ever find their way back home, I hope to be here. To welcome them with open arms. No matter what they have done.

jp: 我らをはぐくむ母なる星よ
us: O great mother, from whom all blessings flow!

jp:
星に生まれし我らに
正しき道を示したまえ
us: We beseech you─cast your light in the dark and lead your children!

jp:
長き旅を終えし子らを　今宵
さだめの地へと迎え入れたまえ
us: Tonight, they return home from their long journey. Welcome them, O mother, with love and grace.

jp: 星とともに　あらんことを
us: May the planet guide us all.

jp:
エアリスさんの勇気ある告白
感動しました
us: Aerith is so courageous, sharing her truth with us! Such character!

jp: みなさまに　星の導きのあらんことを
us: May we all be graced with the planet's wisdom and guidance!

jp:
今宵の儀式への参加
よくぞ　ご決断くださいました
us: I commend you for choosing to participate in this evening's ceremony.

jp:
ここにいる者はみな
エアリスさんの味方です
us: All of us here are friends to Aerith, I promise you.

jp:
エアリスさんのお話を聞けて
すばらしい夜となりました
us: Aerith sharing her story made this evening truly special.

jp:
人々は良くも悪くも　セトラとは
遠く隔たれた世界に暮らしております
us: For better or for worse, this world is a far cry from that in which the Cetra once lived.

jp:
エアリスさん　これまで
さぞおつらかったことでしょう
us: My heart goes out to Aerith. I can only imagine the hardship she must have faced.

jp:
みなさまの旅を
星がお守りくださるように祈り続けます
us: I pray that the planet watches over and keeps all of you from harm on your journey.

jp:
エアリスさんは
すばらしい仲間をお持ちなのですね
us: I'm glad to know that Aerith has friends like you to keep her company.

jp:
これもきっと星のお導き
どうか大切になさって
us: Today's experience was surely the will of the planet. May you cherish it always.

jp: 生まれなんて気にするな
us: You're fine just the way you are!

jp: これからも　負けずにがんばれよ！
us: Don't let 'em get ya down, y'hear?

jp: 俺も守るから　君のこと
us: Know that we'll always support you!

jp: あ……あの　感動しました！
us: Miss, that was just so, so moving!

jp: 話を聞かせてくれて　ありがとう
us: Thank you so much for sharing your story.

jp: あなたのこと　応援してる
us: I want you to know I'm rooting for you!

jp: ここより先は　お通しできません
us: I'm afraid I can't let you past.

jp:
ブーゲンハーゲン様の命により
立ち入りを禁止しております
us: Fellow Bugenhagen has forbidden anyone from entering.

jp:
星とともにあらんことを……
どちらに行かれますか？
us:
Blessings of the planet be upon you.
Are you in need of guidance?

jp:
ひょっひょ　翼をもがれた鳥が
海を泳いできよったか
us: Got ourselves a flightless bird, I see. Certainly no proper boat.

jp:
昔はこの入江がコスモキャニオン巡礼の
起点だったのじゃよ
us: Back in the day, this used to be where folks started their pilgrimage to Cosmo Canyon.

jp:
ここに流れ着いたのもまた
星のお導き……
us: It was the planet's will that led you here. I'm sure of it.

jp:
この場所は古くから
魂の流れ着く場所と考えられていたの
us: People say that lost souls have been drawn to this place for as long as anyone can remember.

jp:
いらっしゃいクエ！
チョコボショップ　見ていってよ
us: Wark-ome! Feel free to have a look at our wares.

jp:
まいどクエ！
チョコボショップ　よろしくな
us: Kweh-m on in! Hope you find what it is you're looking for.

jp: ありがとうクエ！
us: Kweh-m again!

jp: またきてなクエ！
us: Choco-bye for now!

jp: すごい怨念だよ……
us: Talk about an axe to grind!

jp: 呪い殺されるまえに　やるぞ！
us: Why the hell's this thing pissed at us!?

jp: なんだろあれ　嫌な予感がする
us: Uh, something tells me that isn't good.

本日は　すばらしいバウトを

クラウドさん

jp:
今度　ボクも空チョコボで

jp:
星命学はとても興味深いのですが

jp:
だから　ここで学んだことを

クラウドさん

jp:

ボクは　常に

us: I designed a combat trial─just for you!

jp:
たしかに　ＭＡＩにも手伝ってもらいましたが
“ボクが”作りました
us: While it is true that you provided assistance, MAI, I am the one who created it.

jp: ふん……挑戦してみてください
us: At any rate, please give it a try.

jp: クラウド様　お疲れ様です
us: Magnificent work, Cloud.

jp:
コスモエリアのモンスターの手ごたえは
いかがでしょう？
us: Have this region's fiends proved a fitting challenge?

jp:
余裕ですよね
戦闘データを見ればわかります
us: One glance at the data will tell you they are clearly no match for him.

jp: マスターには聞いてません
us: I don't recall asking you!

jp:
せっかくわたくしが
クラウド様と交流を深めようとしたのに
us: If you haven't noticed, I'm trying to have a conversation with Cloud.

jp: 邪魔しないでくれますか――
us: So please qui─

jp:
今回もコンバットコースを作成しましたので
挑戦をお待ちしてますね
us: If you're in need of a challenge, know that another combat trial awaits you.

jp:
お疲れ様でした
コスモエリアの討伐依頼は　これで終わりですね
us: Very impressive work, Cloud. You've completed this region's combat assignments.

jp:
厳しい大地を生き抜いているだけあって
気合いの入ったモンスターばかりでした
us: Such harsh environs as these are bound to engender fiends as brutal as their habitat.

jp:
わたくしのガイドがなかったら
クラウド様といえど危なかったかもしれません
us: They might've gotten the better of you, if not for my informative and entertaining guidance.

jp: マスターもそう思いますよね？
us: Isn't that right, Chadley?

jp:
そんなモンスターたちのデータを使って
新しいコンバットコースを作りましたので
us: The data we've collected from the fiends you fought has helped us create a new combat trial.

jp: そちらも　よろしくお願いしますね
us: I hope you'll find it useful.

jp: ……あれ　無視された？
us: Don't ignore me!

jp: このあたりには　新たなバハムートの祠があります
us: There are sites here dedicated to a Bahamut variant.

jp: 進化した破壊神である『バハムート改』は
us: A variant known as Bahamut Arisen.

jp:
コスモキャニオンの赤土に似た色の装甲をまとい
背中には　生体エンジンを搭載しています
us: With armored scales red as the canyon's soil, and an engine born of flesh mounted on its back...

jp:
防御力　機動力ともに
かつてのバハムートとは比べものになりません
us: its capacity for destruction far surpasses that of the original Bahamut.

jp: 谷で語り継がれている伝説によると
us: According to one of the canyon's legends...

jp:
大昔　激しい戦闘で傷ついた破壊神バハムートが
このあたりに身を隠したそうです
us: Bahamut once took shelter somewhere in these lands after being severely wounded in a fierce battle.

jp:
破壊神は　長い年月をかけて赤い大地の加護を受け
深紅の姿を手に入れたと言われています
us: Its scarlet hue is said to represent the divine protection the earth bestowed upon it during the entity's long convalescence.

jp: コスモエリアに残る言い伝えのひとつに
us: One local folktale goes like this:

jp:
復活した深紅のバハムートが
大地に向かって咆哮をあげたせいで
us: Rejuvenated, the crimson wyrm gave forth a mighty roar.

jp:
巨大な亀裂が入り　峡谷ができた
というものがあります
us: Thus was the very land rent in twain, and the canyon born.

jp:
あまりに破壊神らしい話で
ちょっと笑ってしまいますよね
us: Truly a tale befitting a god of destruction, don't you think?

jp:
これで　コスモエリアにあるクリスタルは
すべて解析できました　お疲れ様です
us: You have now analyzed all the summon crystals in the Cosmo Canyon region. Good work.

jp:
ただ　これ以上バハムート改を強くしてしまって
大丈夫なのでしょうか
us: I must confess I have reservations about making Bahamut Arisen any stronger.

jp:
心強いような　恐ろしいような
複雑な気持ちです
us: I cannot decide if this development is positive or terrifying.

jp:
でも　クラウドさんは
まだ召喚マテリアをお持ちじゃなかったですね
us: Though you have yet to obtain the requisite materia, as I recall.

jp:
まずは　バトルシミュレーターで
召喚獣に挑戦してみてください！
us: You'll first need to confront the divine via the combat simulator!

jp:
クラウド様
ジャバウォックの生息地に到着しました
us: Careful, Cloud! You have just entered jabberwock territory.

jp:
ほとんど生態情報が存在しない
謎多きモンスターです
us: Unfortunately, we know very little about this enigmatic fiend at present.

jp: どうか　万全のご準備を！
us: I suggest you expect the unexpected!

jp: ジャバウォックの出現を確認しました
us: Jabberwock identified in the vicinity.

jp: これより　ガイドを開始します
us: Commencing guidance protocol.

jp:
太古の時代から伝わる
邪悪なドラゴン　ジャバウォック
us: Records that make mention of this dragon date back to antiquity.

jp:
ものを食べずとも千年を生き
足踏みひとつで大地を砕くといった
信じがたい伝承が残っています
us: Some state that this beast could survive for centuries without eating, or split the earth with a single stomp─but I find these claims specious.

jp:
しかし　近年になって
休眠期に入ると赤い大地にもぐり
体を石化させることで　長い年月に
耐えていたことがわかりました
us: That said, recent discoveries have confirmed that it can hibernate for extended periods by petrifying itself and delving deep into the scarlet soil.

jp:
ジャバウォックの活動期は非常に短く
めったにお目にかかれません
us: The jabberwock is, in fact, active for such a short time that it's hardly ever seen.

jp: これは　絶好のチャンスです！
us: We mustn't miss this chance!

jp:
伝説のドラゴンの討伐と調査を
ぜひとも　よろしくお願いします！
us: Please, help us shed some light on this legendary dragon─for science!

jp:
デザートサハギンの希少種を
確認しました
us: Rare desert sahagin variant detected.

jp:
デザートサハギンは　その名のとおり
ミッドガルの地下に生息する
サハギンの近縁種です
us: As their name suggests, these sahagins are closely related to those found living in the sewers of Midgar.

jp:
砂地に適応し変異しているものの
サハギンと同様　社会性と知能を持ち
武器を手に集団で狩りを行います
us: Though they have instead adapted to the desert, they possess the same intelligence and social behaviors, and have been observed hunting in groups with their trademark tridents.

jp:
かつて　コスモキャニオンの戦士たちは
デザートサハギンの甲羅を盾として
活用していたと言います
us: Their protective carapaces are so tough that the warriors of Cosmo Canyon once fashioned them into shields.

jp:
あの凶悪なスパイクなら
守るだけでなく　攻撃もできそうですね
us: I would imagine those fiendish spikes offered them a measure of offense as well.

jp:
地の利はサハギンにあります
餌食にならないように一致団結して
調査にのぞみましょう！
us: Remember: the sahagins have home-field advantage, so take care not to fall prey to their tactics. Best of luck!

jp: キキキアチョの希少種を確認しました
us: Rare skeeskee variant detected.

jp:
金色に輝く羽毛を持つ
キキキアチョの希少種は
その美しさゆえに　かつては
乱獲や闇取引が横行していたと言います
us: The shimmering golden plumage of this variant was once so coveted that they were hunted to the brink of extinction─not that black market dealers cared.

jp:
そんな歴史もあってか
キキキアチョの希少種は
仲間を奪われることに対して
極めて強い防衛反応を示すようです
us: Given this tragic, bloody history, one can hardly fault these skeeskees for their highly aggressive behavior when one of their own is taken from them.

jp:
可愛らしいキキキアチョを苦しめるのは
本意ではありませんが
これも　生態を解明するためです！
us: Loath though I am to subject them to further trauma, I'm afraid this is the only way that we might learn more about them.

jp: 慎重に調査を進めてください！
us: Please try to be as gentle as you can!

jp: グリフォンの希少種を確認しました
us: Rare griffon variant detected.

jp:
グリフォンは鳥と獣の特徴をあわせ持ち
巨大な羽で空を舞い
強靱な爪で獲物を仕留めます
us: Griffons are a union of bird and beast that soar through the skies on mighty wings, and take down prey with sharp claws.

jp:
古くからこの星に生息し
数々の伝承に登場するグリフォンですが
尾羽の持つ幻覚作用ゆえか
正確な調査報告はほとんど存在しません
us: These creatures have existed for eons and appeared in countless legends, yet have never undergone scientific study. Or perhaps those who tried fell prey to the beast's hallucinogens.

jp:
希少種はさらに目撃例もすくないので
これは絶好の機会です！
us: Sightings of this variant are even rarer still, making this a golden opportunity!

jp:
尾羽の動きに警戒しつつ
じっくりと調査を進めていきましょう！
us: Remember, though, to keep an eye on those tail feathers as you proceed with your investigation!

jp: キャッパワイヤの希少種を確認しました
us: Rare capparwire variant detected.

jp:
視力と聴力を持たぬキャッパワイヤは
震動によって外敵を感知し
自由自在に動くツルを用いて
集中攻撃を仕掛けてきます
us: Lacking both visual and auditory senses, the capparwire tracks prey through vibrations in the ground, unleashing a relentless stream of precise attacks with its whip-like vines.

jp:
しなやかさと強靱さを兼ね備える
キャッパワイヤのツルは　古くから
工芸品などに活用されてきました
us: Because capparwire tendrils are both supple and sturdy, humans have used them as a material for handicrafts throughout history.

jp:
特に希少種のツルは耐火性に優れ
もし　火事で家をなくしたとしても
キャッパワイヤのツルは残ると言います
us: The vines of this particular variant are resistant to fire. A house wrapped in them could burn to the ground, and the tendrils would remain.

jp:
希少種のツルの更なる可能性を探るため
ぜひとも　討伐調査をお願いします！
us: There's no telling what untapped potential these plant fiends possess. We're counting on you to help us find out!

jp: バジリスクの希少種を確認しました
us: Rare basilisk variant detected.

jp:
バジリスクは体の色を変化させ
姿を消して獲物に近づき　捕食します
us: Basilisks can change the color of their skin to blend into the environment and hunt prey undetected.

jp:
このステルス能力に注目し
神羅も研究を進めているようです
us: Shinra is studying this fiend in the hopes of replicating its camouflage capabilities.

jp:
また　希少種は姿を消すだけでなく
気温や湿度　光量にあわせて
皮膚の性質ごと変化させ
環境の変化に適応しているようです
us: This variant, however, doesn't simply alter its coloration. It manipulates the properties of its skin in accordance with the temperature, humidity, and lighting of its surroundings.

jp: まさに　コスモキャニオンのシノビ！
us: Its powers are nigh ninja-esque!

jp:
惑わされないよう目をこらして
調査を進めていきましょう！
us: Be sure to rely on all your senses if you don't want to lose track of it!

jp: ゴーレムの希少種を確認しました
us: Rare golem variant detected.

jp:
実のところ　ゴーレムは
生物ではありません
us: Strictly speaking, golems are not "living creatures."

jp:
ライフストリームによって動く
意思なき土人形なのです
us: They're soulless clay dolls, animated only by the lifestream.

jp:
大昔に　古代種の技術によって
生み出されたと考えられています
us: It is thought that the Ancients created them long ago with their unique technology.

jp:
しかし　古代種がなぜこの場所に
ゴーレムを残していったのかは
明らかになっていません
us: Though it remains unclear why they would have left their constructs in a place like this. We may never know the answer.

jp:
主を失ってから月日は流れ
ライフストリームの不純物が体内に
蓄積したゴーレムは
年々　凶暴化していっています
us: After the disappearance of their masters, the golems fell into disrepair. Corrupted by impurities flowing through the lifestream, they grew violent.

jp:
周辺住民への被害も深刻です
討伐調査をお願いします
us: Please put an end to their destructive rampage─for the sake of the locals, if nothing else.
